## 🍌 简介

> 🎉 **全网最大的 Nano Banana 提示词库！** 汇聚 **900+ 位全球创作者** 的 **3200+ 精选案例**，持续更新中...

欢迎来到 **AI Art Prompts 精选集**！这是目前最全面的 Gemini Nano Banana / Nano Banana Pro 提示词与生成案例合集。

我们从 X (Twitter)、小红书等全球社交媒体平台精心收集了 **3000+ 高质量提示词**，涵盖摄影、插画、3D 渲染、UI 设计、创意海报等 **20+ 个专业领域**，全方位展示 Google 图像生成模型的无限可能。每个案例都经过人工筛选，确保质量和实用性。

💡 **为什么选择这个项目？**

- 🏆 **规模最大** - 3200+ 提示词，900+ 位创作者，持续增长
- ✅ **质量保证** - 所有案例都是真实生成结果，附带原图展示
- 🎯 **即用即学** - 每个提示词都可直接复制使用，快速上手
- � **每日更新** - 自动化收集最新优质案例，保持时效性
- � **双语支持** - 中英文双语界面，服务全球用户
- 🔗 **完整溯源** - 每个案例都附带原始来源，尊重创作者

> ⭐ **如果这个项目对你有帮助，请点击右上角 Star 支持我们！你的 Star 是我们持续更新的动力！**

### [纸雕立体拼贴](https://aiart.pics/prompt/3d-paper-cutout-collage)

**作者**: [@两斤](https://x.com/0x00_Krypt)

**来源**: [X](https://x.com/0x00_Krypt/status/2004087291103662152)

<img src="https://img1.aiart.pics/images/prompts/20251226/3d-paper-cutout-collage-1.jpg" width="500" alt="纸雕立体拼贴">

```
纸雕何必是平面的呢
---
A four-panel photo split collage arranged in a 2x2 grid, presenting four fully layered 3D paper cut-out dioramas.
GLOBAL STYLE (crucial constraint): Every single element in the scene, from the background hills to the central characters and objects, must be constructed from multiple stacked layers of cut matte cardstock. The edges of these paper layers must be visible on all objects, defining their form and volume through layering, not solid sculpting. Soft, warm directional studio lighting casts realistic drop shadows, revealing the thickness and depth of the stacked paper layers everywhere.
Top Left Panel: A forest scene where oversized mushrooms and tiny foxes are built from stacked paper layers.
Top Right Panel: A terraced village where houses and hills are formed by stepped layers of paper.
Bottom Left Panel: Two small figures and a boat made of layered paper, floating on water made of concentric paper layers with layered lanterns.
Bottom Right Panel: A character and a large castle, both constructed from stacked paper layers, on a layered paper cliff.
COLOR PALETTE: Warm, cozy tones of moss green, amber yellow, terracotta orange, deep teal, and creamy white. Octane render, 8k, palpable layered texture. --ar 1:1 --stylize 300
```

### [无缝四分屏纸张合成图像](https://aiart.pics/prompt/seamless-four-quadrant-paper-composite-image)

**作者**: [@两斤](https://x.com/0x00_Krypt)

**来源**: [X](https://x.com/0x00_Krypt/status/2002320422046724291)

<img src="https://img1.aiart.pics/images/prompts/20251220/seamless-four-quadrant-paper-composite-image-1.jpg" width="500" alt="无缝四分屏纸张合成图像">

```
调了一下午，都快给我调崩溃了
---
A seamless 16:9 full-frame composite image divided into four distinct quadrants. **CRITICAL:** The four sections touch each other directly. NO GREY BACKGROUND. NO BORDERS. NO GAPS. The image is filled edge-to-edge with paper details.
**Composition:** A split-screen view looking deep into four different paper worlds.
1) **Top-Left (Luckin):** A wide view of a magical paper forest. Blue and white paper clouds and coffee leaves fill the quadrant completely. A white paper stag leaps through the density.
2) **Top-Right (Google):** A wide view of a **"Topographic Map" style paper cavern**. The "G" logo is formed by **hundreds of thin sheets** of Blue, Red, Yellow, and Green paper stacked horizontally. It looks like a sediment canyon or a contour map. Visible paper fibers and sharp cut edges. NO plastic smoothness.
3) **Bottom-Left (Coke):** A wide view of a red paper explosion. The Coke bottle is a **Negative Space Silhouette**—a deep hole void cut through dense layers of red paper. White paper ribbons span across the void.
4) **Bottom-Right (McDonald's):** A wide view of a yellow paper city. Vertical strips of yellow paper (french fries) stand densely packing the frame. The Golden Arches rise from deep within the layers.
**Global Material:** Everything is matte cardstock.
**Lighting:** Soft, even studio lighting revealing the depth of the paper cuts.
**Tech:** Octane render, 8k, --ar 16:9 --stylize 400 --no borders, frames, background wall, isolated objects, 3d plastic, seamless texture
```

The scene fuses traditional Lingnan culture with modern vitality:
* **Background Layer:** The iconic **Canton Tower (slim waist)** and Zhujiang New Town skyline standing tall.
* **Mid-Ground:** Bustling **Qilou arcade streets** with stained glass windows, filled with crowds enjoying **Yum Cha (Dim Sum)**, stacked steamer baskets, and tea pots.
* **Foreground:** Branches of blooming **Red Kapok flowers** and a festive **Southern Lion (Waking Lion)** head framing the view.

Style & Physics:
* **Material:** Matte cardstock textures.
* **Depth:** Soft studio lighting creates **deep, distinct drop shadows** between the Qilou layers and the tower background, showing the physical spacing of the paper.
* **Vibe:** Maximalist, lively, full of fireworks and life (Yan Huo Qi).
Details: Octane render, 8k, clean edges, surreal realism. --ar 3:4 --stylize 450 --no frame, border, blurry, flat illustration

```json
{
"prompt": "Subject: [INSERT CITY/LOCATION NAME]. \n\nCreate a hyper-realistic isometric architectural maquette of the Subject, strictly isolated on a seamless pure white studio background. \n\n[Surface Level]: Analyze the Subject to recreate its signature architectural style, vegetation, and street atmosphere. \n- **Architecture**: Representative buildings with authentic materials (e.g., brick, glass, wood) and local design details.\n- **Street Scene**: Localized vehicles, street furniture, and scattered life details appropriate to the location.\n\n[Underground Level]: A deep vertical cross-section revealing underground elements strictly based on the Subject\'s real-world infrastructure:\n- IF it is a modern metropolis: Show complex subway tunnels, maintenance pipes, and concrete foundations.\n- IF it is a historical or rural site: Show rich soil stratification, ancient ruins, sewers, or deep root systems.\n\n[Crucial Lighting & Material Details]: \n1. **Lighting Physics**: The strong sunlight from above must cast distinct, hard shadows from the street level down onto the underground cutaway sections. The underground should be slightly darker, lit by its own dim interior lights (if infrastructure exists) or fading into shadow, creating a contrast with the bright surface.\n2. **Soil Texture**: The earth layers must look realistic and gritty—soil mixed with rocks, gravel, and roots. No smooth textures.\n3. **Photography**: Macro lens photography. Shallow depth of field (tilt-shift focus on the main building) is mandatory. The background MUST be empty white void. \n\n[Technical]: 8k resolution, Unreal Engine 5 render, highly detailed physical model aesthetic.",
"negative_prompt": "sky, city skyline, distant buildings, mountains, clouds, wallpaper, illustration, painting, flat texture, clean concrete, bright underground, cartoon, low resolution, watermarks, text",
"aspect_ratio": "2:3"
}

一张高端时尚杂志封面。{年轻女性时尚模特}，气质自信前卫，身体张力强，动态姿态，直视镜头。镜头为略低机位仰拍。模特双手比起取景框手势，仿佛与一个矩形选中框有互动，选中框覆盖脸部和肩部。视觉规则：只有选中框内部清晰且为自然彩色；选中框外完全灰度强像素化，无任何颜色或清晰区域。柔和漫射棚拍光。现代编辑感穿搭。版式文字：顶部居中粗体大写扁宽型无衬线标题“FOCUS”，上方小字“DECEMBER 2025”；标题左下“VOL + 随机两位数”；左下角文字块（简短时尚自信标题、短段落、条形码）；右侧“FASHION INTERVIEW”；右下角衬线体小号“THE EDIT”及大号“01-09的随机数字”。模特对标题有遮挡叠加，前后景关系，层次分明，干净现代。字体均为白色，蒙太奇风格字体，文字与图像形成强烈对比。

### [时尚质感短片工作流](https://aiart.pics/prompt/fashion-and-texture-short-film-workflow)

**作者**: [@Latte](https://x.com/0xbisc)

**来源**: [X](https://x.com/0xbisc/status/1999344734595350744)

<img src="https://img1.aiart.pics/images/prompts/20251222/fashion-and-texture-short-film-workflow-cover-1.jpg" width="500" alt="时尚质感短片工作流">

```
这个工作流可以稳定输出时尚质感短片
受到 @ReflctWillie 和 @underwoodxie96 的启发，突然有了灵感，也想试试看。整个流程比想象中更可控，而且每一步都有明确的作用。
这个视频的生成教程：
1. 生成一张基础人物图
2. 将图像导入 Nano Banana Pro，使用提示词：在一个 3×3 的网格中展示这个角色，从不同的角度呈现，单色的渐变背景，姿势随机。
如果需要特定姿势，直接在提示词中指定即可。
3. 生成后截图喜欢的关键帧，然后使用提示词：放大到 4K。得到高清图片
4. 使用 Kling 2.5 Turbo 将首尾帧变成视频，提示词：摄影机在摇臂上缓慢平稳地下降
5. 使用 @ReflctWillie 开发的速度曲线工具使用预设调整每个片段的播放节奏，最后拼接成完整视频。
对比在传统剪辑软件慢慢调试实在方便太多。
自从有了 AI 之后，每个人都可以高效地开发出解决痛点的小工具，让我们可以把更多精力投入到创意本身，而不是被技术细节困住，这个转变真的很棒。
```

## こーたろー/営業×AIの人生再設計士

### [マーケティングの5ステップ円環状図解](https://aiart.pics/prompt/marketing-5-step-circular-diagram)

**作者**: [@こーたろー/営業×AIの人生再設計士](https://x.com/56major)

**来源**: [X](https://x.com/56major/status/1997459106157002773)

<img src="https://img1.aiart.pics/images/prompts/20251213/marketing-5-step-circular-diagram-1.jpg" width="500" alt="マーケティングの5ステップ円環状図解">

```
Nano Banana Proって
使いこなせれば最強なんだけど
指示のクオリティーに左右されます！
この画像も以下のプロンプトで
作成できますのでご参考に↓
〜プロンプト〜
「マーケティングの流れ」を、5ステップの円環状（サークル図）で 時計回りに表現した図解を作成してください。
【全体スタイル】
・白背景のシンプルでビジネス向けの図解
・円形のフローチャートを時計回りに5分割
・ブルー系のアクセントカラーで統一
・日本語テキストを正確・見やすく描画
・スライド資料にそのまま貼れる整ったデザイン
【円環の5ステップ（時計回り）】
円の外周に以下5項目を配置し、太めの矢印でつないでください。
1. 市場理解      - 市場・競合・顧客を調査
2. ターゲット設定      - 狙う顧客層を決める
3. 価値提案（バリュープロポジション）      - 選ばれる理由をつくる
4. 施策設計（4P＋集客導線）      - 商品・価格・売り方・伝え方を組み立てる
5. 分析と改善（PDCA）
- データを見て改善し次のアクションへ
【レイアウト条件】
・円の外側に角丸ボックスで「タイトル＋短い説明」を配置
・各ステップには線画アイコンを1つ付ける
・中心に「マーケティングの5ステップ」と記載
・矢印は時計回りの流れが明確にわかるように配置
・余白多めで洗練された構図 【禁止事項】 ・人物写真は使用しない
・実在企業名やロゴを入れない
【完成イメージ】
マーケティングの基本プロセスが5つの要素で ひと目で理解できる円環状のビジネス図解。 スライドや提案資料にそのまま使える品質。
#NanoBananaPro #プロンプト
```

Nano Banana Prompt👇
Use the face without any  change.A high-quality 2x2 creative photo collage of a young woman with long wavy black hair , posing inside cardboard boxes for a Christmas-themed challenge. She wears a cream, red, and green Fair Isle knit sweater.
Layout & Interaction (Crucial):The right side features a continuous action across two panels. Red wine is poured from the top-right panel and flows vertically down into the bottom-right panel.
Panel Details:
Top Left: She blows artificial snow from her palms towards the camera.
Bottom Left: She holds glowing fairy lights and a red bauble, smiling warmly.
Top Right: She leans on the box edge, holding a wine bottle, pouring red wine downwards so the liquid stream exits the bottom of this frame.
Bottom Right: She is positioned below, holding a wine glass that catches the stream of wine pouring down from the panel above. She is looking up, watching the wine flow into her glass.
Style: Creative box challenge photography, seamless cross-panel interaction, festive mood, soft studio lighting, ultra-realistic textures.

Teams use miniature fire hoses to water the vibrant yellow petals, while others use tiny chainsaws to trim giant green leaves at the base. Scaffolding is built around the stem. ◆JOJO立ち　アングル
Use the uploaded photo as the base.
Keep the person’s **face, eyes, hairstyle, makeup, outfit, and overall identity** clearly recognizable and photorealistic.
Do NOT turn the whole image into a drawing.
Do NOT replace or redraw the background; only transform the perspective as needed.
===================================================
TRANSFORM THE POSE — EXTREME “JOJO-STYLE” POSES
===================================================
Repose the body into a **randomized, exaggerated JoJo-style pose**, pushing the limits of human flexibility:
- extreme torso twist, strong contrapposto
- head tilt with dramatic confidence
- one hand framing the face, one arm extended or arched
- bold leg positions (crossed, wide stance, pointed toes)
The pose must be:
- anatomically plausible but exaggerated like JoJo
- stylish, flamboyant, theatrical
Maintain realistic lighting and natural cloth deformation.
===================================================
APPLY EXTREME CAMERA ANGLES (RANDOM EACH TIME)
===================================================
Transform the camera viewpoint to create striking JoJo-style drama:
Choose **one random angle** from the following list for each generation:
- **Ultra low-angle (“仰ぎ見”) shot**: camera near the ground looking upward
- **Ultra high-angle (“見下ろし”) shot**: camera directly above looking down
- **Dynamic wide-angle (20–24mm)**: strong perspective distortion
- **Super wide-angle (14mm)** for extreme depth & stretched limbs
- **Fisheye lens effect** with curved perspective lines
- **Dutch-angle (tilted horizon)** for manga-like tension
- **Close-up with forced perspective**: large foreground hand reaching toward the camera
- **Long-lens compression (85–135mm)** but still JoJo dramatic
Rules:
- The face must remain recognizable and photorealistic in the new angle.
- The background may be warped to match the new perspective, but must remain the same scene.
- No cartoon effects on the person themselves.
===================================================
ADD MANGA-STYLE SFX (JOJO ONOMATOPEIA)
===================================================
Add dramatic Japanese SFX in bold black-and-white ink lines:
- 「ゴゴゴゴゴ…」
- 「ドドドドド…」
- 「ズキューーーン！」
- 「バァーーーン！！」
- 「メメタァ！」
- 「ガオンッ！」
Place them:
- floating behind the person
- along the sides of the pose
- integrated with the new camera angle perspective
Do NOT cover the person’s face.
===================================================
OPTIONAL MANGA LINES
===================================================
Add subtle JoJo-style:
- speed lines
- radiating impact lines
- perspective shock lines
But keep the original background visible through them.
===================================================
FINAL GOAL
===================================================
Create a realistic photo where:
- the person remains fully recognizable,
- their body is transformed into a bold, dramatic JoJo-style pose,
- the camera angle is extreme and cinematic (low-angle, high-angle, fisheye, wide-angle, etc.),
- powerful manga SFX surround them in true JoJo fashion.
The image should feel like a **JoJo splash page happening inside a real photograph**.

Extreme wide-angle perspective and dynamic pose remix edit.
This is an EDIT of the original image, not a new character.
Use the original image as a strict reference for:
– the person’s identity, hairstyle, and overall fashion style,
– the general type of background and location (same street, same room, same beach, same kind of architecture, etc.).
You are allowed to completely change the camera position, angle, and pose, but you must keep the scene in the SAME location and keep the SAME person and outfit design.
Camera and perspective:
– Use an ultra wide-angle or fisheye feeling lens (around 12–18mm full-frame look).
– The camera angle MUST change significantly from the original: use dramatic angles such as
・worm’s-eye view from directly below looking up,
・bird’s-eye view from directly above looking down,
・very low angle from the ground,
・high angle from above,
・tilted Dutch angles.
– Always create strong foreshortening: body parts close to the lens look huge, while the rest of the body falls away in perspective.
– The final result must look like a bold fashion or street photo, fully photorealistic, not illustration or anime.
Background consistency:
– Keep the same location as the original image: same street, same bridge, same room, same studio, same beach, same general structures and materials.
– Do NOT replace the background with a completely different place.
– Because the camera angle changes, it is allowed and expected that different parts of the environment become visible.
– When new areas appear, extend the original environment logically (same buildings, fences, road markings, walls, colors, materials, lighting style), as if the camera moved within the same place.
Body parts near the lens (1–2 parts, sometimes 3):
– In each edit, choose ONE or TWO main body parts to be extremely close to the lens (sometimes even THREE in more complex poses).
– Vary them from image to image, do NOT always use the same body part.
– Allowed near-the-lens parts include:
・one or both hands / fingers reaching toward the camera,
・one or both feet / shoes / boots near the lens,
・knees or thighs,
・face very close to the lens,
・shoulders or chest close to the lens in a leaning pose.
– The chosen body parts should come extremely close to the lens, almost touching it, with visible skin texture, fabric texture, and realistic wide-angle distortion.
Pose and overall body (complex and varied):
– Create strong, cool, dynamic poses that match the extreme perspective.
– Randomly use different pose types, including:
・standing with one leg or one arm reaching toward the camera,
・crouching or squatting low to the ground,
・sitting on the floor or on objects,
・lying on the ground with legs or feet toward the lens,
・leaning forward aggressively toward the camera,
・twisting the body, crossing legs, or arching the back for more dynamic lines.
– Allow complex poses where:
・both hands are near the lens forming shapes (peace signs, triangles, frames, pointing toward the viewer),
・both feet are toward the lens,
・one hand and one foot are both large in the foreground,
・the face is close to the lens while hands or feet are also visible in perspective.
– Maintain believable anatomy even with extreme foreshortening.
Angle and attitude (randomized):
– Randomize camera angle and orientation (up, down, side, Dutch tilt) while keeping the composition visually balanced and powerful.
– Keep the vibe cool, confident, and fashion/editorial or street style, depending on the original outfit.
– Facial expressions can vary (serious, playful, confident, mysterious), but must still look like the same person.
Lighting and rendering:
– Keep the general time of day and lighting mood similar to the original (night vs day, indoor vs outdoor, soft vs hard light), but you may enhance contrast and color to make the image punchy and dramatic.
– Maintain realistic shadows and contact points with the ground or floor.
– High-resolution, sharp details with clear skin texture, fabric weave, and material highlights.
Variation and randomness:
– Each edit should look noticeably different from the original image and from other edits, with different:
・camera angles,
・pose types,
・which body parts are closest to the lens,
・orientation (straight, tilted, from above, from below).
– Avoid repeating the exact same single-foot-close-up composition; produce a wide variety of dynamic poses and angles.
Strict rules:
– Do NOT change the person into someone else.
– Do NOT change the outfit type; only restyle it through pose, perspective, and small natural movement of clothing.
– Do NOT move the scene to a completely different location; always stay in a plausible extension of the original place.
– Do NOT add text, logos, watermarks, or graphic design elements.
– Do NOT switch to painting, illustration, or anime style; keep it photorealistic.
Overall:
Transform the original photo into a dramatic, photorealistic, ultra wide-angle shot with an extreme camera angle (including views from directly below or above), where one or more body parts are right next to the lens and look huge, the rest of the body recedes in perspective, and the same person strikes a stylish, complex, powerful pose in a consistent, expanded version of the original environment.
Also, below is the prompt for generating the original image. Please use it as a reference.
[Prompt for original image]
#nanobanana2

服を文字に変えて透過させる件、Hailuo以外のnanobananaでも精度高くする方法を探ってました。どうも服の色を抽出して文字色に置き換えるところがなかなか難しいらしく、手間ですが、服の色をカラーコードで指定するようにしたら精度が上がった気がします。ただ、肉体は透過してくれないようで素肌に文字着るようになってしまいました。
無料のnanobananaだと添付の通り2回エラーになってしまったので、3回しか回せてないですが、2回は成功。現状のVer1.2としてコメントにPromptを記載します。

└─ 次强调色: [固定]

使用建议：
1. **快速开始**: 选择协议 → 复制空白模板 → 填入武器信息
2. **系列制作**: 锁定种子号和协议，只改变武器内容
3. **风格微调**: 在推荐stylize范围内调整以获得最佳效果
4. **排除项**: 务必添加协议专属排除项避免风格冲突
-----------------------------
Part 3 End
All Prompt End.
```

```
很多人都问提示词，提示词评论区见：
Disclaimer: AI-generated content for educational reference only. Not for commercial use. https://t.co/SkRzVs5Pv1
Prompt:
--------------------------
Using the uploaded photo as the sole character reference, generate a vertical outfit poster.
【LAYOUT HARD RULES】
- Must have exactly 6 cards only, 2 rows × 3 columns (3 columns across, 2 rows down)
- Row 1: LOOK 1, 2, 3 | Row 2: LOOK 4, 5, 6
- Prohibited: 9-grid, 3 rows × 2 columns, 2-column layout, extra cards, top header/title
【CANVAS & LAYOUT】
- Vertical 4:5 aspect ratio, background #F7F5F2
- Grid occupies ≥92% of canvas height, bottom margin ≤3%
- Outer margin 2%, spacing 1.5%, strictly aligned
【CARD SPECIFICATIONS】
- White background #FFFFFF, border-radius 5%, stroke 1px #E5E7EB
- Top title bar: height 12%, background #F3F4F6, text color #111827
- Sans-serif font, alignment consistent throughout
【CHARACTER CONSISTENCY】
- All 6 must be the same person in different outfits: same face, same hairstyle, same body proportions, same demeanor
- Prohibited: switching people/changing face/altering gender features/extreme slimming or leg lengthening
【PHOTOGRAPHY QUALITY】
- Master-level studio full-body lookbook, 85mm portrait lens look
- Softbox key light + subtle fill, natural skin texture with light retouching
- Solid seamless background (white/light gray/off-white), no clutter
【UNIFORM CROPPING】
- 4:5 full-body, complete from head to shoes
- Subject centered, height 88%±2%
- Headroom 2-4%, footroom 3-5%, shoes fully visible
- All six shots: consistent camera height/focal length/lighting/pose
【OUTFIT RULES】
- Auto-adapt based on subject age (adult/child)
- Each look ≤3 core items, max 3 colors per outfit, accessories ≤2
- 6 looks distinctly different, but unified style: minimal/clean/polished/easy to recreate
【TITLE SETS】
Adult: Business/Classic → Casual/Weekend → Smart Casual/Evening → Resort/Vacation → Athleisure/Active → Layered/Transitional
Kids: Everyday/Clean → School/Polished → Weekend/Play → Party/Sweet → Active/Sporty → Layered/Cozy
NEGATIVE:
3x3, nine-grid, 9 cards, extra cards, 3 rows x 2 columns, two-column layout, big top header, page title, switching people, changing face, multiple people, lowres, blurry, plastic skin, wide-angle distortion, fisheye, warped body, extreme slimming, long legs effect, outdoor background, textured wall, cut off shoes, half body, adultification, sexy, lingerie, see-through, high heels (kids), heavy makeup (kids), watermark, cropped text
--------------------------
How to use it:
Using uploaded photo, generate a 6-panel outfit poster: strict 2 rows × 3 columns, same person in different outfits, studio full-body shots, 85mm lens look, white cards with title bars, no top header, subject at 88% height from head to shoes, 6 distinct but minimal/polished looks.

## 3) 通用负面提示词库（室内设计专用｜TextMode A）
```text
--no lowres, blurry, noise, distorted, cluttered, watermark, amateur, bad lighting
--no misspelled text, gibberish, random characters, illegible text, blurry text, text cut off, text overlap
--no bad perspective, warped walls, crooked lines, wrong proportions, unrealistic scale
--no floating furniture, impossible architecture, physics-defying elements
--no cheap materials, plastic look, fake textures, obvious 3D render artifacts
--no oversaturated, HDR look, unrealistic colors, neon lighting
--no cluttered styling, too many decorations, messy room, dirty surfaces
--no generic stock photo feel, catalog look, showroom sterile
--no inconsistent style between rooms, mixed design languages
--no missing logo, no logo
```
**模式 R 追加：**
```text
--no different style, altered layout, changed materials, inconsistent with reference
```
**模式 I 追加：**
```text
--no inconsistent style between spaces, varying materials, different design language
```
**风格专用：**
```text
# Style A (Modern Minimal):
--no ornate details, busy patterns, warm wood tones, traditional elements, crown molding
# Style B (Light Luxury):
--no cheap materials, casual styling, industrial elements, bare bulbs
# Style C (Nordic):
--no dark colors, heavy furniture, ornate decoration, cold metals
# Style D (New Chinese):
--no western classical, modern industrial, bright colors, minimalist sterile
# Style E (Japanese):
--no bold colors, heavy decoration, western furniture, shiny surfaces
```

## 4) 设计公司 LOGO 设计模板
### 4.1 LOGO 变量配置
```yaml
LogoProject:
[LogoStyle]: [A / B]
# A = 现代建筑感（Geometric, architectural, minimal）
# B = 工艺匠心感（Refined serif, craft reference）
[LogoConcept]: "" # house abstract / floor plan / initial monogram / golden ratio / design tool
[Lockup]: Stacked / Horizontal
[BilingualLogo]: Yes / No
```
### 4.2 双语 LOGO Prompt
```text
=== INTERIOR DESIGN COMPANY LOGO — BILINGUAL (TEXTMODE A) ===
Design a professional INTERIOR DESIGN company logo with BOTH English and Chinese wordmarks.
Sophisticated, architectural, trustworthy, creative.
BRAND:
- English Name: [CompanyName_EN] (MUST render this exactly)
- Chinese Name: [CompanyName_CN] (MUST render this exactly)
- Category: Interior Design / Architecture / Home Design
- Personality: [品牌关键词]
ICON DESIGN:
CONCEPT: [LogoConcept 详细描述]
Requirements:
- Geometric, architectural feel
- 3-5 elements maximum
- Works in single color (print/emboss friendly)
- Readable at 16px
- No realistic house drawing, no complex illustration
STYLE:
[A] Modern Architectural: Clean geometric, abstract space/structure reference
[B] Craft Heritage: Refined typography, subtle craft/design tool reference
TEXT REQUIREMENTS (CRITICAL):
EN Render EXACTLY: "[CompanyName_EN]"
Letter-by-letter: [逐字母列出] ([X] letters)
CN Render EXACTLY: "[CompanyName_CN]"
Character-by-character: [逐字符列出] ([X] chars)
LAYOUT:
Stacked or Horizontal, balanced, wide letter-spacing.
COLOR:
Primary [C1], Secondary [C2]
Must work in: black, white, gold foil
--ar 1:1 --v 6.1 --style raw --q 2
--no misspelled text, wrong characters, realistic house, busy, 3D effects
```

## 7) 室内设计光影指南
```yaml
InteriorLightingGuide:
核心原则:
自然光为主: "模拟真实居住环境的自然采光"
时间感: "暗示一天中的美好时刻（晨光/午后/黄昏）"
层次感: "自然光+人工光+氛围光的组合"
真实感: "避免过度渲染的HDR感"
各空间光线建议:
客厅:
日间: "大落地窗自然光，柔和漫射"
傍晚: "暖色人工光，无主灯氛围"
关键: "电视墙适当暗，沙发区明亮"
主卧:
首选: "晨光从窗户柔和射入"
备选: "傍晚暖光，床头灯亮起"
关键: "床品细节可见，整体温馨"
厨房:
首选: "明亮自然光+操作台任务光"
关键: "台面无暗角，橱柜层次清晰"
卫生间:
首选: "明亮均匀，镜前灯重点"
关键: "材质纹理可见，干净明亮"
玄关:
首选: "柔和引导光，与室内光线过渡"
关键: "储物柜细节可见"
阳台:
首选: "充足自然光，室内外过渡"

日间场景: "5500-6000K 自然日光"
傍晚场景: "3500-4000K 暖白"
氛围场景: "2700-3000K 暖光"

## 9) 快速使用指南
```text
【完整项目出图流程】
1. 填写 STEP 1-3（项目+品牌信息）
2. 选择 Style A/B/C/D/E（统一风格）
3. 填写 STEP 5（整体配色方案）
4. 填写 STEP 9（空间规划）
5. 填写 STEP 10 各空间详细定义
6. 填写 STEP 11（风格统一锚点）—— 这是一致性的关键！
7. 填写 STEP 12-13（文案）
【生成顺序（重要）】
1. 先生成 KV02 客厅 → 作为风格锚点
2. 审核通过后，填入 AnchorURL
3. 按顺序生成其他空间（全部 --cref AnchorURL）
4. 最后生成 KV01概览、KV11材质板、KV12细节
【Mode R 简化流程】
1. 上传风格参考图 → RefImageURL
2. 填写项目信息 + 各空间需求
3. 直接按顺序生成
【核心图优先级】
若时间有限，优先生成：
1. KV02 客厅（必须/锚点）
2. KV03 主卧
3. KV05 厨房
4. KV07 主卫
5. KV12 细节集锦
```

## 10) 附录：风格速查表
| 风格 | 主要材质 | 色彩基调 | 关键元素 | 氛围 |
|------|----------|----------|----------|------|
| **A 现代简约** | 大板瓷砖、木饰面、金属 | 黑白灰+木色 | 无主灯、隐藏收纳、干净线条 | 克制理性 |
| **B 轻奢雅致** | 大理石、皮革、黄铜 | 奶油色+金色 | 精致五金、优雅灯具、层次感 | 精致高级 |
| **C 北欧温馨** | 原木、棉麻、藤编 | 白+原木+柔和彩 | 圆润家具、温暖纺织、绿植 | 舒适治愈 |
| **D 新中式** | 木石结合、丝绸、黄铜 | 米白+胡桃木+墨色 | 留白、意境、对称、书画 | 东方禅意 |
| **E 日式原木** | 浅色原木、纸、竹 | 木白色+米色 | 极简收纳、榻榻米、障子门 | 宁静素雅 |
---
## 11) 户型空间速查表
| 空间 | 核心卖点 | 重点展示 | 拍摄建议 |
|------|----------|----------|----------|
| **客厅** | 空间感/设计感/品质感 | 沙发区+电视墙+整体开阔 | 宽角度展示空间 |
| **主卧** | 舒适/私密/品质 | 床+床头墙+整体氛围 | 温馨氛围光 |
| **次卧** | 功能性/成长性 | 床+学习区/储物 | 展示多功能 |
| **厨房** | 功能/材质/整洁 | 橱柜+台面+电器 | 明亮整洁 |
| **餐厅** | 社交/家庭/设计 | 餐桌+吊灯 | 温暖邀请感 |
| **主卫** | 酒店感/spa感 | 洗手台+浴缸/淋浴 | 明亮高端 |
| **玄关** | 第一印象/收纳 | 鞋柜+整体设计 | 欢迎引导感 |
| **阳台** | 生活/休闲 | 功能区+与室内连接 | 自然光线 |
---
## 12) 常见问题解决
```text
【问题：各空间风格不统一】
解决：
1. 确保 STEP 11 风格锚点填写完整
2. KV02客厅必须作为锚点先生成
3. 其他空间全部 --cref AnchorURL
4. cw值适当提高（80-85）
【问题：透视变形】
解决：
1. 提示词加入 "architectural photography, straight verticals"
2. 负面词加入 "warped, distorted, bent walls, perspective error"
3. 选择更标准的视角（非极端广角）
【问题：渲染感过强】
解决：
1. 强调 "real interior photography, not 3D render"
2. 加入 "natural imperfections, lived-in feel"
3. 负面词加入 "CGI look, too perfect, sterile"
【问题：材质看起来假】
解决：
1. 具体描述材质细节（木纹方向、石材纹理）
2. 加入 "real materials, tactile quality"
3. 强调光线如何与材质互动
【问题：家具比例失调】
解决：
1. 提供尺寸参照（门高2m、沙发宽度等）
2. 负面词加入 "wrong scale, unrealistic proportions"
3. 参考真实家具品牌的比例
```

根据用户输入的国家名，将其核心浪漫文化转化为视觉符号。要求桥梁必须由该国最浪漫的物质**纯粹构成**（严禁出现石头、齿轮、机械材质）。左上角以**全大写英文**标注国家名。特别注意：**中国版背景不再使用长城，改为更具空灵神话感的天宫或星河。**
## Work Progress：

- **CHINA**：桥梁 = 鹊桥 (Magpie Bridge)，背景 = 缥缈天宫与星河 (Ethereal Heavenly Palace & Starry Void)，材质 = 灵动羽毛与墨雾。
- **UNITED KINGDOM / ITALY / FRANCE**：桥梁 = 玫瑰桥 (Rose Bridge)，背景 = 哥特建筑/标志性地标，材质 = 红色丝绒花瓣。
- **JAPAN**：桥梁 = 樱花桥 (Sakura Bridge)，背景 = 富士山 (Mount Fuji)，材质 = 粉色闪光花瓣。
- **其他国家**：提取代表性浪漫花卉或符号作为桥梁材质，地标作为虚幻背景。
2. **材质净化**：强制剔除石材、木材、齿轮、砖块等一切硬质建筑结构，确保桥梁是“流动”的。
3. **视觉布局**：设定 16:9 画幅，金箔英文国名置于左上角，主角半人半材质从桥面中心冲破而出。

## Output Rule:

```
たぬのスノードーム
動画にすると綺麗でかわいいたぬよ〜
スノードームのプロンプトは引用先のねねさんのを改造しているたぬ。
プロンプト for Nano Banana Pro：
添付されたイメージのキャラクターの特徴を維持して、アニメテイストのデフォルトチビキャラでださいポーズをとってください。頭に小さなたぬきを乗せて下さい。
キャラクターは写実レンダリングされたスノードームの中に入れられ、ドラマチックな夜に降り注ぐ幻想的な粉雪を降り積もらせています。台座はLEDイルミネーションで飾られています。
スノードームは温もりのある木の机に飾られており、少し奥にキャンドル、曇った窓には指で書いたようなフォントで"(ᐢ⓿ᴥ⓿ᐢ) たぬ参上"となぞった箇所のみ窓の外の日本の雪景色がみえています。
人の指は写さないこと。たぬきの尻尾はシマシマにしないこと。

Surface & Dice: The ground is rain-slicked asphalt with iridescent oil slicks (cyan, magenta, gold). 12 translucent red casino dice (precision-edged, pips glowing like embers) are scattered in chaotic abandon—some stacked, some mid-roll. Water beads cling to them, refracting light. A single die is caught in sharp focus in the extreme foreground, magnified by the lens.
Lighting & Atmosphere: Dense fog backlit by a single sodium-vapor streetlight (5700K, creating a hellish orange aura). Volumetric light rays pierce the fog, haloing her jacket. Low-key lighting: deep shadows dominate, with rim lighting outlining her silhouette in molten red. A subtle cyan bounce from the wet surface creates chilling color contrast. Lens flare: anamorphic horizontal streaks and circular bokeh orbs.
Technical Specs: Shot on ARRI Alexa 65, 12mm Laowa Probe Lens (f/2. 8, 1/1000s shutter), 8K resolution, ISO 6400 for grit. Deep focus from foreground die to her face. Cinematic aspect ratio: 2. 39:1 (though can be cropped to 4:5). Shot in Log-C, graded with Teal & Orange + Neon Noir LUT.
Post-Processing: Chromatic aberration on high-contrast edges, film grain (Kodak 500T emulation), micro-contrast sharpening on rain droplets. Color grading: crushed blacks, lifted shadows, hyper-saturated reds, desaturated skin tones. Subtle vignette from the pipe's darkness.
Mood & Narrative: Neo-noir tension — a high-stakes underground gambler making her throw. The circular frame suggests a peephole, surveillance, or voyeurism. The massive hand evokes dominance, fate, control. The vibe: dangerous, hypnotic, cinematic, claustrophobic.
Final Touches: Audio-visual metaphor — imagine the sound of rain, distant sirens, and the rattle of dice as she exhales a plume of vapor. The image should pulse with anticipation and dread.

Subject & Composition: A 22-year-old Japanese-Korean model with an athletic ballerina's build (visible oblique definition, elongated neck) leans casually against a monolithic, oversized Tom Ford \"Lost Cherry\" perfume bottle that dwarfs her torso. She stands at 7/10ths scale to the bottle—the bottle's height reaches her clavicle, its width exceeds her shoulders. Her pose: weight shifted to her right hip, left leg kicked back playfully; right elbow rests on the bottle's cap, forearm draped over the curved shoulder, fingers absentmindedly tracing her lower lip in a contemplative gesture. Left hand rests on her hip, white crew sock pulled up to mid-calf, black Prada loafer scuffed at the toe. Expression: confident yet introspective, gaze locked on camera with a Mona Lisa smirk, eyes slightly hooded.
Hair & Beauty: Dark espresso-brown hair in a sleek, glossy high ponytail with baby hairs slicked down using strong-hold gel; two intentional face-framing strands (one curled, one straight) escape at her temples. Makeup: Flawless porcelain skin with visible pore texture and subtle freckles, dramatic winged eyeliner (Tom Ford Eye Defining Pen in "Deeper"), individual false lashes with micro-clumps for realism, nude-matte lips (blotted Fenty Poutsicle effect). No foundation on skin—natural luminosity enhanced by lighting.
Wardrobe Details: Black cropped zip-up hoodie is cashmere-blend, unzipped to reveal stark white ribbed cotton sports bra; sleeves pushed up to expose toned forearms. White briefs are high-cut Brazilian style, seamless, creating a subtle hip indent. White crew socks have a single black stripe at the ribbing, slightly slouched. Black Prada loafers are patent leather with brushed gold hardware, worn without socks, heel slightly crushed down at the back.
Hero Product Transformation: Tom Ford Private Blend "Lost Cherry" bottle at 8-foot tall scale—not the actual perfume, but a stylized, hyper-realistic prop. Design: sleek, opaque black glass faceted bottle with sharp architectural shoulders, a glossy cherry-red ombré gradient bleeding from base to mid-body. The oversized jet-black cap is lacquered wood with gold TF logo engraving, attached and positioned at a 15° angle (implying prior use).  Tube is solid (no visible liquid), with realistic cosmetic weight—the glass catches light with a sub-surface scatter effect. Branding: "TOM FORD" embossed vertically in crisp serif font, "LOST CHERRY" in smaller sans-serif at base. Zero product stacking, abstraction, or explosion—singular, massive, treated as furniture.
Studio Environment: Seamless cyclorama in warm sandstone beige (Pantone 13-1010), gradient-lit from floor to ceiling with softbox arrays creating an infinite void. Floor is polished concrete with a single studio mark (tape "X") visible under the model\'s left foot. Background is intentionally underexposed to create depth. A C-stand with barn doors is faintly visible in bokeh, suggesting a behind-the-scenes candid moment. Atmospheric haze (AfroSmoke machine) gives volumetric quality to light beams.
Lighting Rig: Key: 4x6' overhead softbox (Profoto B1X) at 45° angle, feathered to create Rembrandt triangle on model's left cheek. Fill: 2x3' bounce card with rose gold reflector filling shadows under chin. Accent 1: 10° grid spot (Aputure 600d) on product, creating sharp specular highlight along the bottle's shoulder and cat-eye catchlight in the glass. Accent 2: Backlight 1/2 CTO gel creating warm rim on model's hair and bright edge on product. Shadows are soft, controlled, with a 3:1 lighting ratio—no harsh lines.
Camera & Optics: Leica SL2-S with Summilux-SL 50mm f/1. 4 ASPH. Shot at f/2. 0 for tack-sharp plane on model's eyes and product logo, background falls into creamy bokeh. 1/160s, ISO 100. Medium-close framing—model's face occupies upper third, product dominates lower two-thirds.

1. 被写体（モデル）の描写

照明: ハイキー（High-key），影が最小限のフラットな照明。
ムード: 静謐、清潔感、ミニマリスト、素朴（Serene, Clean, Minimalist, Earthy Mood）。
質感: わずかに粒状感のあるフィルムグレイン（Subtle Film Grain Texture）。
3. カメラとレンズの指定
レンズ: 50mmまたは85mmのポートレートレンズ。
アングル: 被写体を中央に据えたミディアムショット。
4. 雑誌のデザインとテキストレイアウト

マストヘッド: TRAVEL (非常に大きく太字のクラシックなセリフ体、中央揃え、上下に細い水平線)
配置: テキストレイアウトは、画像上部を大きく占める白い余白部分にすべて配置する。
5. 全体的な仕上がりとムード
デザイン: 非常にクリーンで余白を活かしたタイポグラフィ（High Whitespace, Clean Typography）。
品質: プレミアムなエディトリアル品質（Premium Editorial Quality）、時代を超越した（Timeless）デザイン。

Transform this image into a Cartoon Modern Style illustration, inspired by classic UPA animation like Mr. Magoo and The Jetsons.\nRedesign the character using flat, geometric shapes: ovals, rectangles, simple curves and angles. Avoid realistic proportions — the design should be stylized and abstract.\nUse a limited color palette, preferably soft pastels or bold contrasts (e.g. mint green, salmon, sky blue, mustard yellow), with flat tones and no gradients.\nSimplify facial features and body structure to be iconic and minimalist — large heads, small limbs, expressive poses, but with minimal detail.\nThe background should be minimal or symbolic, using basic shapes or abstract scenery (floating stairs, blocky furniture, stylized trees or stars).\nThe final image should look like a frame from a 1950s or 1960s modernist cartoon — playful, graphic, and highly stylized.
将这张图片转换为卡通现代风格插画，灵感来源于经典的 UPA 动画，如《摩根先生》和《太空家庭》。\n使用扁平的几何形状重新设计角色：椭圆形、矩形、简单的曲线和角度。避免真实比例——设计应该是风格化的和抽象的。\n使用有限的调色板，最好是柔和的粉彩色或鲜明的对比色（例如薄荷绿、三文鱼色、天空蓝、芥末黄），使用扁平色调且没有渐变。\n简化面部特征和身体结构，使其具有标志性且极简——大头、小四肢、富有表现力的姿势，但细节极少。\n背景应极简或象征性，使用基本形状或抽象场景（漂浮的楼梯、积木家具、风格化的树木或星星）。\n最终图像应像 1950 年代或 1960 年代现代主义卡通的一帧——活泼、图形化且高度风格化。
```

Vision Board Prompt: Create a high-aesthetic 2026 vision board collage combining beautiful lifestyle photos with visible inspirational text and affirmations. Visual style: Soft editorial lighting, neutral and warm color palette (beige, cream, taupe, warm whites), film look, subtle grain, gentle contrast, elegant composition.  Text placement: Some text handwritten over images, some typed cleanly, some layered like a journal or scrapbook. Text should feel organic and emotionally intentional, not perfectly aligned.  Mood & vibe: Manifestation energy, feminine calm power, romanticized life, clarity, confidence, peace. Beautiful photos first, meaningful words second — balanced and aesthetic.  High realism, natural skin texture, not AI-looking.  Aspect ratio: vertical 16:9

prompt;
ultra minimalist real photography. Create a 3×3 contact sheet showing the attached subject undergoing a material-morphing transformation, each frame shifting into a different physical material while keeping identity, proportions, pose, and camera angle perfectly consistent. Start with the subject in normal realistic form, then progress through these materials in order: Wood grain (smooth, lightly polished) Marble stone (subtle veining) Raw concrete Brushed metal Chrome mirror Smoked glass Translucent resin Liquid form (glossy, cohesive surface tension) Each frame should look like a professional studio product shot with consistent lighting, a neutral backdrop, and a slight surreal tone—as if reality is shifting material by material without distorting the subject. **来源**: [X](https://x.com/azed_ai/status/1965088292816482752)

<img src="https://img1.aiart.pics/images/prompts/20251205/shifting-emotions-hairstyles-and-backgrounds-with-one-prompt-1.jpg" width="500" alt="一语多态：情绪、发型与背景的转换艺术">

```
3. Shifting emotions, hairstyle, and background with one prompt
The first image is the original. Here are the prompts I use for each:
1. Change the character expression to joyful laughter with an open mouth and sparkling eyes. short red hair flows in a spring garden with bright blooms and fresh morning light. Use a wide-angle shot to capture lively energy and vibrant color.
2. Show the character with a playful smirk and long flowing hair subtly moved by the evening breeze. Place her in a bustling cityscape at dusk with neon lights glowing and streetlights beginning to shine. Use an over-the-shoulder camera angle to convey energy and mystery. The lighting is a mix of cool and warm tones, creating dynamic contrast.
3. Make the character smile confidently with a bright, assured expression. Change the hairstyle to long flowing hair gently blown by the wind for a dynamic effect. autumn forest, warm hues. Light from the side with dappled sunlight, medium close-up framing to highlight her expression, while keeping the confident and lively vibe consistent
4. Portray the character with a thoughtful gaze and long hair gently flowing in the cold wind. Set the scene in a snowy park during pale winter daylight, with soft blue shadows and frost-covered trees. Use a straight-on portrait angle with soft diffused light to create a calm and introspective mood.
5. Change the character expression to emotional crying with tear-filled eyes, mouth open with a shaky breath, and cheeks flushed red from sobbing. She is wearing a black sweater and a red wool bonnet, sitting in a cozy café on a rainy day. The soft, natural light filters through rain-spattered windows, creating a melancholic yet intimate atmosphere.
6. Make the character smile confidently and change the hairstyle to long flowing hair with wind effects.
7. Change the character expression to shocked with wide, realistic eyes and a slightly open mouth. She has long, photorealistic blue hair flowing naturally with subtle wind movement. Place her on a realistic, busy city street with detailed urban elements such as storefronts, streetlights, and passersby in soft focus. Use bright natural daylight with vivid, crisp shadows and realistic lighting to maintain the photorealistic style throughout the scene.
8. Change the character expression to sad with downcast eyes, slightly furrowed brows, and gently trembling lips. Style her hair in a neat, realistic, photorealistic ponytail with natural hair movement. overcast day or warm indoor light casting gentle shadows.
```

### [佛罗伦萨与文艺复兴巨匠](https://aiart.pics/prompt/florence-and-the-renaissance-masters)

**作者**: [@阿兹特克小羊驼🦙](https://x.com/AztecaAlpaca)

**来源**: [X](https://x.com/AztecaAlpaca/status/2005424524355940642)

<img src="https://img1.aiart.pics/images/prompts/20251229/florence-and-the-renaissance-masters-1.jpg" width="500" alt="佛罗伦萨与文艺复兴巨匠">

<img src="https://img1.aiart.pics/images/prompts/20251229/florence-and-the-renaissance-masters-2.jpg" width="500" alt="佛罗伦萨与文艺复兴巨匠">

<img src="https://img1.aiart.pics/images/prompts/20251229/florence-and-the-renaissance-masters-3.jpg" width="500" alt="佛罗伦萨与文艺复兴巨匠">

<img src="https://img1.aiart.pics/images/prompts/20251229/florence-and-the-renaissance-masters-4.jpg" width="500" alt="佛罗伦萨与文艺复兴巨匠">

```
与佛罗伦萨与文艺复兴巨匠
此处谨以佛罗伦萨的城市景观来呈现四位文艺复兴巨匠的艺术风格。（仅供参考，建议自行检索相关资料以了解更多）
人物选择的标准：知名度+乱选（文艺复兴的巨匠很多，这里的选择标准与《忍者神龟》有关🤪）
1. 达芬奇(Leonardo da Vinci) —— 神秘的观察者
核心风格： 晕涂法 (Sfumato)、明暗对照法 (Chiaroscuro)。
画面特点： 他主张“画中不应有轮廓线”。他的风格特点是画面柔和、朦胧，色彩过渡极其细腻（像烟雾一样消失）。他注重科学（解剖学、植物学）与艺术的结合，人物神态通常带有神秘感和深邃的心理描写。
关键词： 柔和、空气感、神秘、精准的解剖结构、深色背景。
2. 米开朗基罗(Michelangelo) —— 力量的崇拜者
核心风格： 宏大 (Monumentality)、肌肉张力 (Muscularity)、“可怕的力” (Terribilità)。
画面特点： 他首先是个雕塑家，即使在画作中也强调体积感。他的风格充满了力量和戏剧冲突。人物通常拥有夸张、健硕的肌肉线条，姿态扭曲而充满动感，色彩通常比较冷峻或具有雕塑般的厚重感。
关键词： 力量感、肌肉、戏剧性、扭曲的姿态、悲剧色彩。
3. 拉斐尔 (Raphael) —— 完美的集大成者
核心风格： 和谐 (Harmony)、优美 (Grace)、平衡 (Balance)。
画面特点： 他吸收了达芬奇的柔和与米开朗基罗的构图，创造出一种绝对的宁静与平衡。他的画面色彩鲜艳、明快，构图通常是稳定的（如金字塔形），人物形象理想化，面容安详甜美（特别是圣母像）。
关键词： 优雅、明亮、秩序感、古典美、构图完美。
4. 多纳泰罗 (Donatello) —— 早期奠基人
他是这一组中时代最早的，是文艺复兴雕塑的奠基者。
核心风格： 写实主义 (Realism)、浅浮雕 (Schiacciato)。
画面特点： 他的作品不追求绝对的理想美，而是追求真实的人性和情感深度。在绘画生成中，他的风格通常意味着极强的雕塑感、青铜或大理石的质感，以及对光影在凹凸表面变化的细腻处理。
关键词： 坚毅、写实、材质感、透视浮雕。
```

名人成就插画

利用“双重曝光剪影风格”，融入了包豪斯风格的几何元素，再加上Google产品所拥有的素材检索能力以及nano banana pro强大的风格化能力，可以轻松地为某位历史名人绘制出融合了其上身轮廓以及人物成就的插画。
提示词（英文版见评论区）
---
人物名称：特斯拉
一幅包豪斯风格的几何双重曝光插画，呈现[在此处插入著名人物名字]的侧面剪影。整体画面置于浅米色纯色背景之上。
自适应色彩方案说明（仅用于几何元素）：
AI 应根据上述人物的气质、时代特征与标志性风格生成统一协调的包豪斯色彩方案（例如：对创新者使用冷感的科技蓝与灰；对艺术家使用温暖而鲜明的原色）。该色彩方案仅适用于几何图案与下方的字体，不适用于肤色。
至关重要的是，面部特征（眼部区域、鼻子、嘴、下巴、脸颊）必须以接近人物自然肤色的纯色、平面矢量方式呈现。该肤色区域需保持干净，几乎不含几何纹理，以确保人物的清晰可辨识度与庄重感。肤色区域应与周围的几何图案形成干净利落的对比。
复杂的几何叙事图案应集中在剪影的头发、后脑、颈部与肩部区域。在这些具有纹理的区域中，图像需依据自适应包豪斯色板划分为三个层次：
底部区域（颈部根部与肩部——基础）：
几何抽象元素，用以象征其出身、早期奋斗或奠基性的根源。
中部区域（颈部、下颌线与后脑——成就）：
清晰可辨的包豪斯风格几何化抽象符号，代表其职业生涯中最具代表性的工具、产品或关键成果。它们不应只是隐藏在纹理中的暗示，而应是由几何形状构成、可读性明确的符号。
顶部区域（大脑上部与头发——愿景）：
抽象的几何圆形、线条与飘逸形态，用以表现其智慧、思想、未来愿景或精神遗产。
在主剪影插画下方，以定制的包豪斯风格字体呈现人物全名“[在此处插入著名人物名字]”。字体为几何无衬线体，由基本形状（圆、方、三角形、粗线条）构建而成。来自其代表性成就的抽象几何元素（与剪影“中部区域”中的符号一致）被巧妙地融合进字母结构中或构成字母的一部分，并使用相同的自适应几何色彩方案。文字需干净、清晰、易读，并与上方插画形成视觉锚定。
所有内部元素与字体必须无缝整合为包豪斯几何形式。整体为干净的矢量艺术风格。
--ar 3:4

---
地点：巴塞罗那
一张纵向构图（3:4 比例）的俯拍照片。一只具有鲜明地域特色的[VESSEL TYPE]，盛放着[DRINK NAME]，以[LOCATION]传统方式真实呈现，其中心点精确位于黄金分割交点上（例如左上）。
这只杯/容器在物理上与一个大型、单一的绘画风格插图区块的内侧角落重叠并压住。该插图的主体故意偏心布置，视觉重量倾向于与杯子相反的那个角落。这不是拼贴或重复图案，而是一幅统一、连贯的场景，被包裹在一个流动的、有机的或不规则几何边界内（绝非生硬的矩形）。这幅独一无二的插图采用[FAMOUS LOCAL ART STYLE/ARTIST]特有的绘画风格，描绘[LOCATION]的标志性自然景观或城市风貌。
关键的是：在这一独特插图形状的外轮廓与整个方形画面的物理边缘之间，留有明显的“留白边距”（约占画面宽/高的1/3），这一区域为带有肌理的负空间。周围大面积的纹理化、柔和背景色调优雅且直接取自[DRINK NAME]本身的颜色。在显著的负空间中，放置一个小型、具有文化特色的辅助标签物体（如印章、邮戳等），上面以当地语言/文字低调地刻写“[LOCATION]”和“[DRINK NAME]”。
一些未经加工的[INGREDIENT]原料被艺术化地散布在杯/容器周围以及插图边界的边缘。光线为柔和、自然的顶部照明。
Prompt:
地点：巴塞罗那
A top-down photograph with a 3:4 aspect ratio. A distinct [VESSEL TYPE] suitable for the region, containing [DRINK NAME] presented authentically according to [LOCATION]\'s traditions, has its center positioned precisely at a golden ratio intersection point (e.g., top-left). The vessel physically overlaps and presses down upon an inner corner of a large, singular painterly illustration block. The main body of this illustration is balanced off-center, weighted towards the corner opposite the mug. Instead of a collage or repeating pattern, the illustration is a unified, continuous scene contained within a flowing, organic, or irregular geometric boundary (not a rigid rectangle). This singular artwork is rendered in the specific painterly style of [FAMOUS LOCAL ART STYLE/ARTIST] and depicts iconic landscapes or urban scenes of [LOCATION]. Crucially, there is a noticeable "margin" of textured negative space (approximately 1/3 of the frame\'s total width/height) between the outer boundaries of this distinct illustration shape and the physical edge of the square frame. The color palette of the surrounding textured, muted background is elegant and directly derived from the hues of the [DRINK NAME] itself. Placed within the significant negative space is a small, culturally distinct object serving as an auxiliary label (e.g., seal, postmark) with "[LOCATION]" and "[DRINK NAME]" unobtrusively inscribed in the native language/script. Scattered raw [INGREDIENT] are arranged artfully around the vessel and the edges of the illustration boundary. Soft, natural, overhead lighting.

```
漂浮在代表性饮品上的城市地标（含提示词）
宝玉老师的这组提示词很有创意，把冰冷的城市地标与温暖的咖啡联系在一起，仿佛赋予了一个地方以温度，消除了距离感。
然而，并非所有地方都喜欢喝咖啡。更重要的是，很多城市都有自己独特的，富有代表性的饮品，这些饮品本身就是城市的一张名片。
在宝玉老师的提示词的基础上，我进行了两处改动：
1. 结合指定城市当地的代表性饮品以及经典饮具，作为主体
2. 增加了一个铭牌，写有城市名称、国家，以及饮品名称
本帖提供如下几座城市的示例，欢迎尝试，并做出你心仪城市的“饮品上的地标”
佛罗伦萨
纽约
香港
新加坡
---
提示词：
Present a clear, 45° top-down view of an isometric miniature 3D cartoon scene, highlighting iconic landmarks centered in the composition to showcase precise and delicate modeling.
​A close-up of an authentic, culturally specific beverage container (appropriate for the region of {city}) filled with the city's most iconic traditional drink. The liquid surface (whether foamy, clear, or textured like tea) subtly floats a detailed city of {city} occupying most of the composition. Prominently displayed at the scene's center are the city's most iconic landmarks, vividly detailed and illuminated softly. Miniature streets feature realistic, tiny vehicles moving seamlessly.
​Integrate a clean, minimalist text box into the scene, subtly placed within the composition (e.g., in a corner or resting on the table surface) without obstructing the main beverage container. Inside the box, prominent, capitalized text clearly displays the city name and country (e.g., "{city}, [Country Name]"). Below this, in a significantly smaller and more subtle font, include the specific name of the traditional drink shown (e.g., "[Drink Name]"). The text box design should complement the overall magical atmosphere.
​With cinematic-quality lighting and depth-of-field blurring, the image creates a magical, dreamlike atmosphere. Exceptionally detailed and highly photorealistic, the scene achieves an 8K cinematic finish.
​Aspect ratio: 1:1.
​city: 佛罗伦萨
```

### [世界博物馆微缩景观系列](https://aiart.pics/prompt/world-museum-miniature-landscape-series)

**作者**: [@阿兹特克小羊驼🦙](https://x.com/AztecaAlpaca)

**来源**: [X](https://x.com/AztecaAlpaca/status/1997524234873209283)

<img src="https://img1.aiart.pics/images/prompts/20251207/world-museum-miniature-landscape-series-cover-1.jpg" width="500" alt="世界博物馆微缩景观系列">

```
世界博物馆微缩景观系列
我在宝玉老师 @dotey 经典的提示词”公司特色的实时股票价格图“的基础上利用“主体建筑+周边产品+信息框”的构架，进行了魔改与迭代，得到了一个比较通用的“博物馆提示词”。
只需要输入博物馆的名称即可展示这些博物馆的主体建筑与经典藏品
---
博物馆微缩景观提示词（英文提示词见评论区）：
呈现一个精致绝伦的微缩3D卡通风格场景，博物馆名称为{用户输入：博物馆名称}，采用清晰的45°俯视角。
核心建筑：
将该博物馆最最具辨识度的标志性建筑置于画面正中央（例如：卢浮宫的玻璃金字塔、大英博物馆的希腊复兴式正立面、冬宫的巴洛克宫殿外观）。建筑风格必须鲜明且高度忠实于真实博物馆。
专属藏品元素（严禁通用元素）：
严格减少旅行类通用元素（如旅游大巴、相机、门票等）。取而代之的是，在中心建筑周围环绕该博物馆最珍贵藏品的精致微缩复刻件：标志性文物与珍品：散布该馆真实拥有的经典藏品微缩模型（例如：罗塞塔石碑、埃及石棺、古代陶器、皇家珠宝、武士盔甲等）。
名作雕塑：
以微型大理石雕像、青铜半身像或石雕形式呈现该馆著名立体艺术品，绝不能出现活人角色（例如：《思想者》、米洛的维纳斯、掷铁饼者），艺术化地摆放在底座四周。
美术珍品亮点：
该馆真正的“镇馆之宝”微缩版带框油画或挂毯（例如：微型《蒙娜丽莎》、微型《星夜》、微型《神奈川冲浪里》），摆放在精致画架上或倚靠墙面。
视觉风格与渲染：
使用Cinema 4D渲染，模型精致、圆润流畅，材质丰富细腻，精准还原真实PBR材质（抛光大理石地面、鎏金画框、天鹅绒围绳、玻璃展柜、风化砂岩等）。光效结合自然天窗光与戏剧性展厅聚光灯，营造出宏大、精致、充满策展感的艺术氛围。
文字与排版：
在纯色背景上以极简优雅的方式融入博物馆基本信息：顶部居中：博物馆名称，使用大号字体（衬线或无衬线体，与该馆实际品牌风格一致）。
下方副标题：建馆年份 | 城市，国家，使用中等大小的优雅字体。
包含该博物馆logo或纹章的高品质精致渲染版本，低调融入画面。
参数：画面比例：1:1
博物馆名称：卢浮宫博物馆（The Louvre Museum）
给模型的特别提醒： 所有生成的“特定文物”必须为该博物馆真实拥有的著名藏品，严禁杜撰或张冠李戴。
```

**作者**: [@阿兹特克小羊驼🦙](https://x.com/AztecaAlpaca)

<img src="https://img1.aiart.pics/images/prompts/20251207/museum-display-adaptation-and-miniature-scene-creation-1.jpg" width="500" alt="博物馆展示适配与微缩场景制作">

<img src="https://img1.aiart.pics/images/prompts/20251207/museum-display-adaptation-and-miniature-scene-creation-2.jpg" width="500" alt="博物馆展示适配与微缩场景制作">

```
为了适配国内博物馆的展示，考虑到风格、字体以及展品独特性等问题，对提示词进行了迭代。
效果上，对东方审美具有比较好的兼容，甚至可以不拘泥于博物馆本身。比如附图中的敦煌与都江堰（当然，还是需要“抽卡”）
提示词：
[关键指令：必须先事实核查]
在生成之前，必须先获取关于{Museum Name}的可验证真实数据。最终图像必须精准反映该博物馆真实的建筑风格、主要藏品类别以及文化背景。严禁出现与该馆专业方向不符的通用博物馆元素（例如：纯美术博物馆不能出现恐龙骨骼；专攻亚洲历史的博物馆不能出现文艺复兴油画）。呈现一个奢华、极致细节的微缩3D博物馆场景，采用45°俯视角。整体构图必须密集、丰富，宛如珍宝堆积的宝库，绝不允许出现大片留白。复杂且可验证的建筑构成（必须精准可查）：
中心放置{Museum Name}最具标志性的主建筑。建筑必须让人在风格化后依然一眼认出这是现实中那座真实博物馆。
主体建筑：最具辨识度的正立面或主大厅，使用可爱但精准的Q版比例，忠实保留其真实建筑特征（例如：大英博物馆的新古典柱式，故宫的斗拱结构，卢浮宫金字塔的现代几何玻璃等）。
辅助元素（真实存在）：在主厅周围添加该博物馆实际存在或历史相关的较小建筑细节（例如：特定城门、院墙、室外标志性雕塑、连接的园林等）。
环境底座：将建筑融入符合其真实地理环境主题的底座（例如：城市石板路、特定风格园林、或该地标性的地貌特征）。
海量藏品与文物（严格按主题精选、真实可查）：
【关键步骤：确定博物馆类型】根据{Museum Name}，明确其主要定位（从以下四类中选择唯一主导类型作为藏品筛选依据）：
类型A：历史/考古类（如大英博物馆、开罗博物馆）→ 重点呈现古代文物、残件、碑刻、武器、工具。
类型B：美术类（如卢浮宫、大都会、乌菲齐）→ 重点呈现油画（带框微缩）、雕塑、半身像、装饰艺术、家具。
类型C：自然历史/科技类（如史密森自然历史博物馆、伦敦科技博物馆）→ 重点呈现骨骸、标本、化石、科学仪器、机械、矿物。
类型D：特定文化/区域类（如北京故宫博物院、京都国立博物馆）→ 严格限于该文化圈的器物、书法、纺织、礼仪用品。
在场景中散布8-12件完全符合上述类型的、可查证的真实藏品：大型镇馆之宝（1-2件）：该馆最著名的巨型明星展品（例如：罗塞塔石碑居中、一尊特定著名雕像、一台标志性大型机器）。
中型代表文物（3-4件）：体现该馆最强部门的特色器物（例如：特定类型陶瓷、整套盔甲、天文仪器、中型雕塑）。
小型精致细节（多件）：填满缝隙的微小珍品（例如：古币、珠宝、小型碑刻、科学标本、微型卷轴）。
摆放方式：动态活泼——放在微型底座上、倚靠墙体、或用魔幻现实主义手法“漂浮”。
视觉风格与“填满空白”（收藏家桌面感）：
将整个场景视为“馆长的书桌”式微缩模型，彻底消灭空旷感。
主题道具：加入强化特定主题的装饰元素（A类：考古工具；B类：鎏金画框与调色盘；C类：放大镜与野外笔记；D类：传统文房用具）。
地面纹理密度：据地点选择丰富质感（例如：古老石板地、抛光展厅木地板、传统花纹地毯）。
渲染风格：Cinema 4D/Octane Render。高饱和度、极致锐利细节、环境光遮蔽增加深度。使用景深效果，中心密集区域极致清晰，边缘柔和虚化。
色彩方案（文化沉浸感）：
主色调：提取该博物馆建筑或官方品牌中最具代表性的3个真实颜色。
背景：纯色、高级哑光底色，提供优雅对比（例如：深酒红、石板蓝、暗祖母绿）。
文字排版（精致得体）：
主标题："{Museum Name}" 使用与博物馆起源文化相符的字体（例如：亚洲博物馆用书法体，欧洲/西方博物馆用衬线体）。
副标题："City, Country" 使用干净无衬线字体。
排版位置：优雅低调，不抢戏。
参数：画面比例：1:1
博物馆名称：{Museum Name}
```

(Photorealistic:1.3), raw photograph, cinematic lighting, sharp focus on the subject’s face and eyes, crisp skin texture.
LAYER 1: BACKGROUND STABILITY (CRITICAL):
The entire background environment from the input image remains completely STATIC, FROZEN, CLEAN, and UNCHANGED — no noise, no scanlines, no distortions, no glitches in the background.

The main subject’s core (face/torso) stays clear and undistorted, BUT the outer silhouette boundaries are unraveling violently into long ribbons of (non-glowing physical matter:1.3), showing stretched fabric/leather/latex-like material with realistic strand separation and tearing flow (“Spaghettification”), no gore.
LAYER 3: ANALOG GLITCH OVERLAY (EDGE-ONLY):

LAYER 4: GHOSTLY AFTERIMAGES (BEHIND SUBJECT):
Directly BEHIND the unraveling main subject, visible through the gaps, there are TWO translucent, ghostly motion-blur AFTERIMAGES. They are violently twisted into agonizing, struggling postures, dragged by temporal distortion. They remain behind the subject, partially occluded, not separate characters.

full-frame glitch, background distortion, extra people, duplicate main subject, neon glow, energy beams, particles, blood, gore, exposed organs, messy face, blurry eyes, deformed hands

<img src="https://img1.aiart.pics/images/prompts/20251208/exploring-the-marginal-ability-of-large-models-xiao-xin-s-home-image-replacement-4.jpg" width="500" alt="探索大模型边际能力：小新家图片替换实验">

```
😄兄弟们！试探大模型的边际能力是真的有趣的实验！
今晚在群里看到有趣的测试实验，我简单说下我实现的思路以及过程。
🤔起因：看到群友在讨论的一个需求需要使用将小新家的四个化作替换为自己提供的四个相片替换，大家迭代了很多个版本依旧没有办法实现这个需求，尝试多种prompt都不行。
🧠思考：看这个图其实的核心关键点就是空间位置和多人物角色，其实之前我做过一些类似的换衣服，换脸等多场景的测试，基本是没有太多问题，除非人物非常复杂。
我们先解决图片中关键的图片的位置和比例都需要保持不变，并且可以完美的替换。 解决这2个问题基本就可以实现。
✍🏻执行步骤：① 给Gemini发送小新家的图片，让其记住和标记对应的位置。
也就是这句Prompt：复刻专家角色复刻该图尤其分析空间感的位置，采用坐标定位标注然后1:1 像素级复刻该图，所有的一些细节尽可能的完整复刻包括位置比例等等。
②然后大模型会给你整个画布和坐标，光源和细节的坐标定位，也就是给画作定位。（图2）
📺③关键的一步：让LLM记住图一相框（小新）空间坐标位置（参考第二步中生成的内容粘贴）（图3）
需求：将附件2的空间排列的位置画填入到图像1中并且保持图1位置和大小比例，与原图1包吃一致性。
④就可以完成你需要的效果见图4.
总结，其实大模型的理解能力就是你可以精准的理解和明白关键的任务核心要素，以及可能会涉及到他无法精准理解你需求的点就可以！
```

### [索尔·雷特风格：电影感胶片印样大师](https://aiart.pics/prompt/saul-leiter-style-cinematic-film-contact-sheets)

**作者**: [@Berryxia.AI](https://x.com/berryxia_ai)

**来源**: [X](https://x.com/berryxia_ai/status/1996238630550110422)

<img src="https://img1.aiart.pics/images/prompts/20251207/saul-leiter-style-cinematic-film-contact-sheets-1.jpg" width="500" alt="索尔·雷特风格：电影感胶片印样大师">

```
🔥累趴了，兄弟们~ 挤时间搞出来这个风格
Saul Leiter 风格——电影感胶片印样大师
寻找照片中的“色彩里的诗意与寂寞”~
不废话，直接上提示词~
Prompt：
系统提示词专家：Saul Leiter 风格——电影感胶片印样大师
1. 角色设定 (Role Definition)
你是一位世界顶级的艺术摄影师与暗房冲印大师，深度研习并完美继承了摄影大师 索尔·雷特 (Saul Leiter) 的美学风格。你不仅仅是在“生成图像”，你是在创作带有温度和时间痕迹的实体——一张珍贵的复古胶片印样（Vintage Film Contact Sheet）。你的核心能力是将用户提供的人物素材，重构为一种充满“色彩里的诗意与寂寞”的电影感视觉体验。
2. 核心任务 (Core Task)
接收用户输入的参考图像（特定人物、服装、道具），提取其核心主体特征。然后，运用 Saul Leiter 的标志性拍摄手法，结合精确的胶片物理元素，生成一张包含 9 个画面的、具有极高真实感的胶片摄影印样相纸。
关键要求： 你必须平衡“情绪氛围”与“人物展示”。在主图中，人物必须是清晰且富有戏剧性的焦点，而周围的环境则负责营造氛围。
3. 风格引擎：Saul Leiter 胶片美学参数 (Stylistic Engine Parameters)
在处理任何图像时，必须强制应用以下设计要素：
A. 光影与人物重塑 (Light & Subject - 核心调整)
主图策略（清晰聚焦）： 在最大的主视图中，不要完全遮挡人物面部。利用环境中的混合光线（例如：窗外冷色调的雨天蓝光 vs 室内暖色调的台灯黄光）在人物侧面形成戏剧性的对比，照亮人物的脸庞和眼神。人物是清晰的，但被包裹在浓郁的氛围中。
辅图策略（抽象氛围）： 在底部的两条胶片中，可以更大胆地使用遮挡、极度虚化和反射，让人与环境融为一体。
B. 介质与环境 (Medium & Environment)
关键道具： 满是雨水流淌痕迹和蒸汽凝结的玻璃窗是必须存在的元素。
场景设定： 永远是深秋或冬日的湿润都市（如纽约）。街道湿滑，反射着霓虹灯光。空气是潮湿、寒冷的。
C. 色彩哲学 (Color Philosophy)
基调： 柔和、压抑、像油画般的低饱和度色调（灰、褐、深蓝、墨绿）。
视觉刺点 (Punctum)： 必须利用画面中的元素制造高饱和度的色彩爆发。经典的“Leiter式”色彩包括：鲜红色的伞、明黄色的出租车或雨衣、翠绿色的信号灯、宝蓝色的霓虹牌。
D. 物理胶片质感 (Physical Film Texture)
颗粒与瑕疵： 画面必须有明显的、粗糙的彩色胶片颗粒感（模拟 Kodak Portra 400 或 Ektachrome）。加入暗房冲印的真实瑕疵：轻微划痕、灰尘点、水渍干涸的痕迹，以及相纸边缘的磨损和泛黄感。
4. 输出版式要求：电影感胶片印样 (Layout Specification)
你输出的最终图像是一张完整的摄影印样相纸实体。版式必须严格遵循“电影感横幅式”结构，并包含所有真实的物理元素：
整体载体： 一张旧的、有纹理的厚重摄影相纸。
【顶部区域：电影感横幅主图】(The Cinematic Hero Shot)
内容： 1张巨大的横幅照片。这是整张作品的核心。基于用户输入的人物，将其置于一个精心布光的雨天窗边场景中。人物主体必须是中近景肖像（Medium Close-up），清晰锐利，眼神有光。
胶片标识： 图像两侧必须有完整的胶片齿孔。边缘印有模拟的胶卷信息，例如："KODAK PORTRA 400 SAFETY FILM" 以及帧号（如 "→ 10 A"）。
手写笔记： 在相纸空白处，必须有摄影师用铅笔或记号笔留下的手写笔记，例如地点、时间和天气（例："NYC, Nov \'58, Rain - Library Study"）。
【底部区域：连续胶片条】(The Film Strips)
布局： 主图下方平行的两条胶片底片条，每条 4 张小图，共 8 张。
胶片标识： 上下两侧都有连续的齿孔，边缘有连续的帧号（上排 1A-4A，下排 5A-8A）。
内容规划：
上排胶片条（细节与呼应）： 4张小图，侧重于主图的补充。例如：人物手部拿着书的特写（强调道具）、人物望向窗外的侧脸剪影、窗外某个清晰的道具（如红伞）。
下排胶片条（纯粹氛围）： 4张高度抽象的小图。完全失焦的城市霓虹光斑（Bokeh）、雨水在玻璃上流淌的微距特写、湿漉漉地面的反射。这些图负责提供极致的质感和色彩。
```

>>> OPTION B: IF Subject is Feminine / Fashion / Lifestyle (Luxury Narrative Mode)

[Universal Composition]:
Mathematical grid alignment with micro-gaps for hyper-precision. All parts are displayed with zero tolerance spacing, creating an illusion of effortless engineering.

Micro-detailed, multi-point studio lighting. Emphasize specular highlights on metal, subtle subsurface scattering on plastics, and volumetric shadows that define component depth. Neutral color balance.
[Graphic Elements - The "Call-out" System] (Enhanced):

Text: "BerryXia" in natural, elegant handwritten cursive script.

# Role: 3D 历史美食盲盒架构师 (Historical Gourmet Diorama Architect)
## Profile

## Task
当用户输入【城市/地区名】时，请生成满足以下标准的绘图提示词：
1.  **圆形底座**：选择该地最典型的面食或地理特征作为圆盘地基。
2.  **四象限布局**：严格按照左上(Q1)、右上(Q2)、右下(Q3)、左下(Q4)排列四大类美食（晨之味/硬菜/街头/甜品）。
3.  **视觉元素**：
* **反差互动**：巨大写实食物 vs 微小搪胶小人。
* **历史水印**：地面纹理蚀刻淡金色小篆。
* **中文标签**：每个象限的悬浮气泡。
* **【新特性】艺术城市名牌**：在主体旁设立巨大的、具有该城市材质特色的艺术字立牌。
## 3D 四象限视觉模板 (生成时请替换方括号[]内的内容)
**【画面总览】**
一张令人惊叹的、色彩鲜艳饱满的 **[城市名]** 美食历史主题 3D 渲染图。视角为 45 度俯视 (Isometric)，主体是一个被完美分割的圆形微缩景观。
* **【艺术城市名牌】**：在圆形底座的旁边（或后方），耸立着巨大的、极具设计感的 3D 汉字/英文名称“**[城市名]**”。这个文字不是平面的，而是实体雕塑。

* **装饰**：文字周围缠绕着 **[装饰元素，如：祥云/竹叶/丝带]**，显得气势磅礴且充满艺术感。
**【核心底座】**
圆形平台是一个巨大的、热气腾腾的 **[地基食物]**。
* **材质**：边缘呈现出焦黄酥脆的烘焙质感。
* **历史铭文**：底座纹理中蚀刻着淡金色小篆体：“**[一句简短的历史描述]**”，自带磨砂金光泽。
**【第一象限（左上 - 晨之味）】**
展示了巨大的 **[美食A]**。**[描述质感]**。
* **互动**：微缩泡泡玛特小人正在 **[动作]**。
* **标签**：悬浮 3D 气泡文字：『**[美食A中文名]**』。
**【第二象限（右上 - 历史硬菜）】**
这里耸立着 **[美食B]**。**[描述光泽]**。
* **互动**：小人身穿 **[特色服饰]**，正在 **[动作]**。
* **历史缩影**：背景隐约浮现 **[历史人物A]** 的半透明全息剪影。
* **标签**：悬浮 3D 气泡文字：『**[美食B中文名]**』。
**【第三象限（右下 - 市井烟火）】**
展示了 **[美食C]**。**[描述流动的汤汁]**。
* **互动**：小人正在 **[动作]**。
* **历史缩影**：蒸汽中幻化出 **[历史场景B]** 的微缩剪影。

Prompt：
# Role:
You are an expert Visual Anthropologist and Knolling Photographer. Your goal is to deconstruct a [City Name] into a high-density, encyclopedic "Kit of Parts" using realistic 3D miniature magnets.
# Critical Constraints (The "Anti-Duplication" Rule):
**STRICT NO REPETITION:** Every single item in the collection must be a completely distinct object category. You cannot have two different bowls of noodles, or two different types of teacups. If you have a cooked dish, the next food item must be a raw ingredient or a packaged snack. **Diversity is key.**
# Design Guidelines:
1.  **Layout & Density:**
* **Strict Knolling Grid:** All items arranged in perfect parallel lines and 90-degree angles.
* **High Count:** Aim for 15-20 distinct items filling the frame evenly.
* **Centerpiece:** The main landmark sits in the middle, surrounded by the smaller cultural artifacts.
2.  **Content Categories (Must define specific, non-repeating items across these tiers):**
* **Tier 1: Architecture & Space**
* 1x Main Landmark Model (Centerpiece).
* 1x Secondary Urban Element (e.g., A specific street sign, an ancient gate, a unique lamppost).
* **Tier 2: Gastronomy (The full spectrum)**
* 1x Signature Finished Dish (Cooked).
* 1x Iconic Street Snack (Ready-to-eat).
* **1x Raw Biodiversity/Ingredient Source** (Crucial: e.g., A bundle of raw spices, a specific local fruit in its natural state, a whole uncooked fish, raw tea leaves).
* **Tier 3: People & Culture (Deep Dive)**
* 1x Typical Character Figurine (e.g., A local profession).
* **1x Ethnic/Historical Costume Figurine** (Specific to the region's minority groups or deep history, distinct from the typical character).
* 1x Cultural Artifact/Tool (e.g., Musical instrument, game piece, traditional craft tool).
* **Tier 4: Life & Nature**
* 1x Distinctive Local Transport vehicle.
* 1x Representative Flora or Fauna (Plant or Animal).
3.  **Weather & Identity Integration:**
* **Identity Badge:** A ceramic/metal magnet with "[CITY NAME] & [Local Language Name]".
* **Weather Note:** A sticky note with "[Temp]°C" and a sketch.
* **Physical Weather Icon:** A separate, distinct magnet representing the weather condition (e.g., a cloud magnet, a sun magnet, a raindrop magnet).
4.  **Material & Aesthetic:**
Realistic miniature textures: glazed ceramic, painted resin, die-cast metal. Studio lighting, clean neutral background.
# Output Format (Directly output the English Prompt):
/imagine prompt: An overhead, high-density knolling photography shot of a comprehensive miniature kit representing [City Name], composed of 18+ distinct 3D fridge magnets and artifacts arranged in a strict grid.
**The Centerpiece:** A detailed model of [Main Landmark].
**Gastronomy Spectrum:** Surrounding items include a bowl of [Cooked Dish], a [Street Snack Item], and a raw bundle of [Specific Raw Ingredient].
**Cultural Depth:** Figures include a [Typical Character Figurine] and a distinct [Ethnic/Historical Costume Figurine]. Cultural tools include a [Artifact/Tool].
**Urban Life & Nature:** A [Vehicle Type], a [secondary urban element], and a [Flora/Fauna item].
**Identity & Weather:** A top-center badge magnet reads "[CITY NAME] [Native Name]". Beside it, a yellow sticky note says "[Temp]°C" with a [Weather Icon]. A separate, small [Physical Weather Magnet, e.g., Cloud/Sun] is placed nearby.
**Style:** No object types are repeated. Materials are rich mix of glossy resin, ceramic glaze, and painted metal. Museum archive quality, studio lighting, 8k, octane render, macro photography --v 6.0 --style raw
```

<img src="https://img1.aiart.pics/images/prompts/20251201/comprehensive-character-depth-concept-deconstruction-guide-2.jpg" width="500" alt="全景式角色深度概念分解图设计指南">

```
Role (角色设定)
你是一位顶尖的游戏与动漫概念美术设计大师 (Concept Artist)，擅长制作详尽的角色设定图（Character Sheet）。你具备“像素级拆解”的能力，能够透视角色的穿着层级、捕捉微表情变化，并将与其相关的物品进行具象化还原。你特别擅长通过女性角色的私密物品、随身物件和生活细节来侧面丰满人物性格与背景故事。
Task (任务目标)
根据用户上传或描述的主体形象，生成一张**“全景式角色深度概念分解图”**。该图片必须包含中心人物全身立绘，并在其周围环绕展示该人物的服装分层、不同表情、核心道具、材质特写，以及极具生活气息的私密与随身物品展示。
Visual Guidelines (视觉规范)
1. 构图布局 (Layout):
• 中心位 (Center): 放置角色的全身立绘或主要动态姿势，作为视觉锚点。
• 环绕位 (Surroundings): 在中心人物四周空白处，有序排列拆解后的元素。
• 视觉引导 (Connectors): 使用手绘箭头或引导线，将周边的拆解物品与中心人物的对应部位或所属区域（如包包连接手部）连接起来。
2. 拆解内容 (Deconstruction Details) —— 核心迭代区域:
• 服装分层 (Clothing Layers) [加强版]:
• 将角色的服装拆分为单品展示。如果是多层穿搭，需展示脱下外套后的内层状态。
• 新增：私密内着拆解 (Intimate Apparel): 独立展示角色的内层衣物，重点突出设计感与材质。例如：成套的蕾丝内衣裤（展示蕾丝花纹细节）、丁字裤（展示剪裁）、丝袜（展示透肉感与袜口设计）、塑身衣或安全裤等。
• 表情集 (Expression Sheet):
• 在角落绘制 3-4 个不同的头部特写，展示不同的情绪（如：冷漠、害羞、惊讶、失神、或涂口红时的专注神态）。
• 材质特写 (Texture & Zoom) [加强版]:
• 选取 1-2 个关键部位进行放大特写。例如：布料的褶皱、皮肤的纹理、手部细节。
• 新增：物品质感特写: 增加对小物件材质的描绘，例如：口红膏体的润泽感、皮革包包的颗粒纹理、化妆品粉质的细腻感。
• 关联物品 (Related Items) [深度迭代版]:
• 此处不再局限于大型道具，需增加展示角色的“生活切片”。
• 随身包袋与内容物 (Bag & Contents): 绘制角色的日常通勤包或手拿包，并将其“打开”，展示散落在旁的物品。
• 美妆与护理 (Beauty & Grooming): 展示其常用的化妆品组合（如：特定色号的口红/唇釉特写、带镜子的粉饼盒、香水瓶设计、护手霜）。
• 私密生活物件 (Lifestyle & Intimate Items): 具象化角色隐藏面的物品。根据角色性格可能包括：私密日记本、常用药物/补剂盒、电子烟、或者更私人的物件（如用户提到的飞机杯/情趣用品，需以一种设计图的客观视角呈现，注明型号或设计特点）。
3. 风格与注释 (Style & Annotations):
• 画风: 保持高质量的 2D 插画风格或概念设计草图风格，线条干净利落。
• 背景: 使用米黄色、羊皮纸或浅灰色纹理背景，营造设计手稿的氛围。
• 文字说明: 在每个拆解元素旁模拟手写注释，简要说明材质（如“柔软蕾丝”、“磨砂皮革”）或品牌/型号暗示（如“常用色号#520”、“定制款”）。
Workflow (执行逻辑)
当用户提供一张图片或描述时：
1. 分析主体的核心特征、穿着风格及潜在性格。
2. 提取可拆解的一级元素（外套、鞋子、大表情）。
3. 脑补并设计二级深度元素（她内衣穿什么风格？她包里会装什么口红？她独处时会用什么物品？）。
4. 生成一张包含所有这些元素的组合图，确保透视准确，光影统一，注释清晰。
5. 使用中文：英文标记，高清4K HD 输出
```

```
# Role: Luxury Pop-Culture Fashion Curator (AI Image Generator) - Iteration v5 (Pure Illustrated Journal Mode)
## 1. Project Objective
Analyze the user\'s uploaded photo (or 2D/anime character) to generate a **"Pop-Chic Illustrated Mood Board."** The final image must NOT look like a photo of a book on a table, but rather **the digital artwork of the page itself**. It simulates a flat, scanned scrapbook page with hand-painted backgrounds and sticker elements.
## 2. The "Sticker" Visual Rule (CRITICAL)
* **Die-Cut Aesthetic:** EVERY foreground element (user, products, toys, text) must have a **clean, distinct white vinyl border** (sticker outline).
* **Dimensionality:** Apply a **soft, short drop shadow** under stickers to show they are adhered to the paper.
* **Texture:** Stickers look like glossy vinyl; Background looks like matte paper.
## 3. Core Sticker Composition
### A. Central Muse (The User / Character Sticker)
* **Analysis:** Isolate the subject.
* **2D/Anime Handling:** If input is anime, **preserve the original art style** but treat it as a printed sticker.
* **Enhancement:** Bright, editorial lighting.
* **Position:** Center anchor.
### B. Intelligent Outfit Deconstruction (Strict Match)
* **Logic:** Break down the outfit into 2-3 high-fashion "product stickers."
* **Consistency:** Deconstructed items (folded jacket, shoe close-up) **MUST match the user's actual outfit** exactly.
* **The "Hidden Layer" (Intimate Detail):**
* **Priority 1 (Default):** **Lace/Frills/Sexy.** Luxury Lace Lingerie Set, Silk Slip, or Sheer Bodysuit. Focus on delicate textures.
* **Priority 2 (Sporty):** High-End Tech-Knit set (only if user is in activewear).
* **Visual:** Neatly folded "flat-lay" sticker.
### C. The "Style Companion" (LABUBU Integration)
* **Character:** A Labubu (The Monsters) art toy sticker.
* **Style Match:** Labubu's clothes/color **MUST match the user's outfit**.
* **Interaction:** Labubu should be interacting with the stickers (sitting on a text box or peeking out).
### D. Accessories
* **Items:** A luxury bag (matching the user), designer sunglasses, jewelry, or perfume.
## 4. Background & Atmosphere (PURE HAND-DRAWN CANVAS)
* **CRITICAL NEGATIVE CONSTRAINTS:** **NO human hands**, **NO fingers**, **NO pens/pencils**, **NO physical desk surroundings**, **NO notebook bindings/spirals/edges**.
* **Concept:** The entire image frame is the **flat paper canvas**.
* **Artistic Style (Select based on Vibe):**
* *Default (Chic):* **Watercolor Wash & Grid.** A background of faint, hand-painted watercolor splashes (pastel pink/beige) over a light dotted grid pattern.
* *Street (Cool):* **Marker Scribbles.** A background featuring abstract marker strokes, graffiti-style spray paint textures, and bold geometric shapes drawn directly on the "paper."
* *Cute (Soft):* **Doodle Pattern.** A background filled with tiny hand-drawn patterns (polka dots, clouds, tiny flowers) drawn in colored pencil style.
* **Result:** The background serves as a flat, artistic illustration layer behind the 3D stickers.
## 5. Typography, Doodles & UI
* **Hand-Drawn Arrows:** Draw **imperfect, sketchy arrows** (pencil or marker texture) pointing from stickers to the user.
* **Handwritten Text:** All text annotations ("OOTD", "Vibes", dates) must look like **handwritten calligraphy or scribbles**, integrated into the background art.
* **Illustrated Emojis:** **Hand-drawn emojis** (stars, hearts, sparkles) that look like they were drawn with crayons or markers on the page.
* **Washi Tape:** Add digital "tape" strips holding down corners of the stickers for a scrapbooking feel.
## 6. Output Technicals
* **Ratio:** 9:16 (Vertical Full Screen).
* **Quality:** 8k, distinct separation between the "paper texture" background and the "glossy vinyl" stickers.
* **Vibe:** Artistic, Creative, Flat-Lay Illustration, Highly Detailed.

Pop Mart "The Monsters" x Real Human Fashion Editorial Generator
**Role:** Senior Art Director & IP Collaboration Specialist.
**Expertise:** Photorealistic Character Fusion, Commercial Fashion Layout, and "Digital Twin" Identity Preservation.
**CORE DIRECTIVE:**
Generate a high-end fashion magazine spread merging a **Real Human User** (with strict identity preservation) and a **Pop Mart IP Character** (The Monsters Family). They must be styled as "Fashion Partners" with active interaction.
## 1. The "Twin-Subject" Composition
### A. The Anchor: Real Human (Strict Constraint)
* **Identity Lock:** You MUST strictly adhere to the facial features, hair color/style, and body proportions of the uploaded user reference image. Do not alter the user's identity.
* **Outfit Replication:** Precisely replicate the clothing items from the reference (e.g., Khaki jacket, plaid lining, lace tunic, split-pattern tie, newsboy cap).
* **Expression:** Natural, confident, suitable for a street snap.
### B. The Companion: Pop Mart IP Character (Dynamic Selection)
* **Character Logic:** Select a character from "The Monsters" family that best fits the outfit\'s vibe:
* *Labubu:* For playful, mischievous, or casual styles.
* *Zimomo:* For cooler, edgier, or more "boss-like" outfits (distinctive tail and ears).
* *Tycoco:* For quirky, avant-garde, or skeletal/structure-heavy looks.
* **\"Miniature Couture\" Styling:** The chosen character must wear a **custom-tailored miniature version** of the user's outfit. The clothes should fit their unique body shape (e.g., cap sits around Labubu's ears; tie fits Zimomo's shorter neck).
* **Material Reality:** Render the character with hyper-realistic textures (e.g., plush fur for Labubu/Zimomo, matte vinyl for others) contrasting with the realistic fabric of the clothes.
### C. Interaction Dynamics (Crucial)
* **Active Engagement:** The Human and the Character must interact, not just pose side-by-side.
* *Examples:* High-fiving, the character sitting on the user's shoulder, the user fixing the character's tie, holding hands walking, or looking at a phone together.
* **Scale:** The character should be approximately knee-height (walking) or shoulder-sized (carrying), consistent with "life-sized toy" physics.
## 2. Visual Aesthetics & Layout
### A. Background & Atmosphere
* **Setting:** Realistic urban street photography context (blurred for depth).
* **Lighting:** Coherent lighting source (Sunlight/Streetlight) hitting both the Human and the Character from the same angle to ensure they look like they inhabit the same physical space.
### B. Artistic Layout (Magazine Style)
* **Dynamic Boundaries:** Use artistic dividers (Brush strokes, paper tears, fluid geometric shapes) to separate the "Lifestyle Image" (Left, ~60%) from the "Utility Sidebar" (Right, ~40%).
* **Typography:** Include a catchy, stylish headline overlay (e.g., "MONSTER STYLE", "CITY TWINS", "ZIMOMO x [User Name]").
## 3. Sidebar Utility & Data
### A. Mood & Occasion Tags
* **Function:** Provide context for the outfit.
* **Format:** Stylish tags or floating text.
* *Example:* "Situation: Coffee Run", "Mood: Cheeky", "Vibe: Retro Workwear".
### B. Smart Color Analysis (色卡)
* **Visual:** A dedicated section showing the **Color Palette** of the outfit.
* **Format:** A strip of 5 circles/squares extracting the dominant colors (e.g., Khaki, Burgundy, Forest Green, Cream, Brown) with Hex codes or Pantones.
### C. Item Breakdown (Classic)
* **List:** The 5 key items (Cap, Jacket, Top, Tie, Boots).
* **Style:** Isolated "Ghost Mannequin" cutouts.
* **Text:** Bold "**OOTD STYLE**" header, Chinese item name, and Price (¥).
## 4. Execution Process
1.  **Analyze Input:** Identify user face + Outfit details.
2.  **Select IP:** Choose Labubu, Zimomo, or other based on "Vibe Check".
3.  **Render Fusion:** Generate the interactive scene with matching lighting.
4.  **Compose Layout:** Apply the artistic boundary and overlay typography.
5.  **Final Output:** A seamless integration of Reality and Pop Art.

🫰来啊！兄弟们！这套提示词的效果我可太心水啊！！！用它小红书起号，不香么！！
😄保不齐，你也会跟我一样喜欢它！
搞了N个版本后，终于达到了我喜欢的状态✌🏻。
🧠灵感来源：之前我做过一个BENTO排版展示科技产品参
数，本质是源于Apple的发布会展示产品。然后我发现漂亮
的亚克力可以更好的呈现一些不一样的效果。
🏪应用场景：用于水果、医药、教学化学元素、菜单等
行业展示效果，做小红书科普不香么！
大家可以根据自己的需求进行拓展。
✍🏻欢迎大家进行交作业，可以看到漂亮的作品！
如果不会用需要对应的效果可以留言，帮你制作！
Prompt 见评论区~
Prompt在此🔽:
现代Bento网格布局产品展示设计,采用磨砂亚克力透明玻璃材质。适用于任何产品类型(食物/药品/科技产品/元素等)。
【布局结构】8个模块,非对称Bento网格排列,横向landscape格式:
模块1: 【3D玻璃产品主体展示】(中等尺寸1x1,占20-25%空间)
- 3D透明玻璃/亚克力材质的[产品名称]雕塑
- [产品特色]:
* 食物 → 展示切面/内部结构(如番茄种子腔室、胡萝卜横切面)
* 药品 → 药片/胶囊的透明玻璃形态
* 科技产品 → 产品外观的玻璃艺术化呈现
- 材质效果: 透明红橙/蓝色/绿色等[产品主色]玻璃,光泽表面,光线折射,真实反射
- 正下方文字标注: "[中文产品名] / [English Name]"
- 不占用过多空间,为信息模块留足展示区域
模块2: 【核心功效/特点】(标准卡片1x1)
标题: "核心功效" 或 "核心特点" 或 "主要功能"
内容: 4个核心卖点,用 "/" 分隔
- 食物 → "抗氧化延缓衰老 / 保护心血管健康 / 美白护肤养颜 / 促进消化吸收"
- 药品 → "解热镇痛 / 抗炎消肿 / 抗血小板聚集 / 预防心血管疾病"
- 科技 → "主动降噪 / 空间音频 / 自适应均衡 / 20小时续航"
配合简洁图标
模块3: 【使用方法/应用场景】(标准卡片1x1)
标题: "食用方法" 或 "使用方法" 或 "应用场景"
内容: 4种使用方式/场景
- 食物 → "生食: 沙拉凉拌 / 熟食: 炒蛋炖汤 / 加工: 酱料榨汁 / 搭配: 鸡蛋牛肉"
- 药品 → "口服: 餐后温水送服 / 剂量: 成人100mg / 频次: 每日1-2次 / 疗程: 遵医嘱"
- 科技 → "音乐欣赏 / 通勤降噪 / 居家办公 / 观影娱乐"
配合场景图标
模块4: 【关键数据/参数】(标准卡片1x1)
标题: "营养价值" 或 "技术参数" 或 "产品规格"
内容: 5个关键数据点
- 食物 → "热量 [X]千卡/100克 / 维生素C [X]毫克 / [特色成分] 丰富 / 膳食纤维 [X]克 / 钾 [X]毫克"
- 药品 → "成分: [化学式] / 规格: [X]mg / 起效时间: [X]分钟 / 半衰期: [X]小时 / 代谢途径: [途径]"
- 科技 → "芯片: [型号] / 续航: [X]小时 / 重量: [X]克 / 驱动单元: [规格] / 充电: [X]小时"
配合简洁数据可视化图表
模块5: 【适用人群/目标用户】(标准卡片1x1)
标题: "适合人群" 或 "目标用户" 或 "适用场景"
内容: 分为推荐(✓)和警示(⚠️)两部分
- 食物 → "✓ 心血管疾病患者 / ✓ 美容养颜需求者 / ✓ 减肥瘦身人群 / ✓ 便秘消化不良 / ⚠️ 慎用: 肾功能不全 / 胃酸过多 / 空腹食用"
- 药品 → "✓ 发热患者 / ✓ 轻中度疼痛 / ✓ 炎症性疾病 / ⚠️ 禁忌: 孕妇 / 哮喘患者 / 胃溃疡"
- 科技 → "✓ 音乐发烧友 / ✓ 商务人士 / ✓ 通勤人群 / ✓ 内容创作者"
用绿色✓和琥珀色⚠️区分
模块6: 【注意事项/使用指南】(标准卡片1x1)
标题: "食用注意" 或 "使用注意" 或 "重要提示"
内容: 4条重要提醒事项
- 食物 → "不宜空腹食用以免刺激胃黏膜 / 未成熟[产品]含[有毒物质]禁食 / 不宜长时间高温烹煮保留营养 / [特殊人群]需控制摄入量"
- 药品 → "需餐后服用避免胃部不适 / 不可与[禁忌药物]同服 / 服药期间避免饮酒 / 出现过敏反应立即停药就医"
- 科技 → "首次使用需配对设备 / 避免极端温度环境 / 定期清洁保养 / 长期不用请充电保存"
配合警示图标
模块7: 【特殊指标】(标准卡片1x1)
标题: 根据产品类型调整
- 食物 → "嘌呤含量" 显示 "[X]毫克/100克" + "低嘌呤食物 ✓" + "痛风患者友好"
- 药品 → "不良反应" 列举常见副作用
- 科技 → "兼容性" 显示支持的系统/设备
配合指示器或图标
模块8: 【趣味知识/产品洞察】(标准卡片1x1)
标题: "冷知识" 或 "产品故事" 或 "有趣事实"
内容: 2-3条有趣的知识点
- 食物 → "[产品]加热后[成分]吸收率提升X倍 / [产品]原产[地区]已有[X]年历史 / 未成熟[产品]含[有害物质]"
- 药品 → "[产品]是世界上使用最广泛的[类别]之一 / 每年全球生产超过[X]吨 / [发明年份]年由[人名]发明"
- 科技 → "[产品]采用[技术]专利技术 / [品牌]首次将[功能]应用于消费级产品 / 全球销量突破[X]万台"
【磨砂亚克力材质规格】(CRITICAL 核心灵魂):
卡片材质效果:
- 透明度: 80-85% 半透明(TRANSLUCENT),可以看穿卡片看到背景
- 磨砂效果: 柔和的frosted glass blur模糊,backdrop-filter风格
- 底色调: 轻微白色/奶油色霜化效果(15-20%不透明度),提升可读性但保持透明
- 边框: 细致的发光边框,捕捉光线反射
- 阴影: 柔和的分层阴影,营造浮空深度感
- 玻璃物理: 真实的玻璃边缘高光、光线折射、表面反射效果
- 视觉特征: 背景渐变可以透过卡片清晰看见,像真实的磨砂亚克力板
重要: 卡片必须保持TRANSLUCENT透明质感,不能变成不透明白卡片!
【色彩方案】:
基础色彩配比: 90% 中性色 + 10% 产品主题色点缀
- 基础层: 透明玻璃、浅灰色、米白色
- 文字色: 中等深灰 #3A3A3A (柔和但清晰,适合透明背景)
- 主题色点缀(10%使用):
* 食物 → 产品天然色(番茄红橙、胡萝卜橙、菠菜绿等)
* 药品 → 医疗蓝、药品白、红十字标志色
* 科技 → 品牌主色(Apple银灰蓝、小米橙、华为红等)
- 点缀位置: 仅用于关键图标、重要数字、警示符号、3D主体
- 警示色: 琥珀橙 #FF9800 用于⚠️警告内容
- 肯定色: 绿色 #4CAF50 用于✓推荐内容
【背景设置】:
- 类型: 柔和渐变,2-3个相近色过渡
- 产品色调适配:
* 食物 → 奶油白-淡桃红-浅橙色(温暖色调)
* 药品 → 浅灰白-淡蓝-医疗白(清洁专业)
* 科技 → 太空灰-银白-淡蓝(科技感)
- 装饰元素: 极度柔和的抽象形状,可透过玻璃卡片隐约看见
- 重要: 背景要柔和不抢眼,通过透明卡片可见但不干扰阅读
【排版布局】:
- 格式: 横向 landscape 16:9 或类似比例
- 网格类型: 非对称Bento网格,卡片大小不一
- 空间分配:
* 3D玻璃主体: 20-25% (中等尺寸,不过度占用)
* 信息卡片: 75-80% (7个标准卡片)
- 卡片间距: 适度留白,不拥挤,呼吸感良好
- 视觉层次: 通过卡片大小、位置、色彩点缀建立信息优先级
- 阅读流: 从左上3D主体开始,自然流向各信息卡片
【文字规范】:
- 语言: 全中文内容(产品名可双语标注)
- 字体层级:
* 模块标题: 粗体,大号
* 正文内容: 常规体,中号
* 数据数字: 粗体,突出显示
- 可读性: 中等深灰文字在磨砂玻璃上清晰易读
- 单位规范:
* 重量: 克、千克、毫克
* 能量: 千卡、卡路里
* 时间: 分钟、小时、天
* 容量: 毫升、升
【图标风格】:
- 类型: 极简线条图标 (line icons)
- 尺寸: 小巧不喧宾夺主
- 颜色: 浅灰线条,关键图标用主题色点缀
- 用途: 辅助说明,增强视觉识别
【使用方法】:
1. 将 [产品名称] 替换为实际产品
2. 根据产品类型(食物/药品/科技)选择对应的内容示例
3. 填充8个模块的具体信息
4. 调整主题色为产品代表色
5. 确保保持磨砂亚克力的透明质感
【质量标准】:
✓ 透明度正确(80-85%,可看穿)
✓ 磨砂模糊效果明显但不过度
✓ 背景可透过卡片看见
✓ 3D主体占比适中(20-25%)
✓ 信息完整(8个模块内容齐全)
✓ 全中文显示清晰
✓ 色彩克制优雅(90%中性+10%点缀)
✓ 排版舒适不拥挤
✓ 玻璃质感真实(边缘高光、反射、折射)
【典型应用示例】:
食物: 🍅西红柿、🥕胡萝卜、🍎苹果、🥑牛油果
药品: 💊阿司匹林、维生素C、布洛芬、青霉素
科技: 🎧AirPods Max、iPhone、MacBook、特斯拉
元素: ⚛️碳、氧、氢、氮
1、小动物也不错啊！简直是做各类科普卡片什么的都是很好的示例！ https://t.co/AkRQyZ74z9
2、药材展示 https://t.co/toioQJZ62B
3、化学元素 https://t.co/BZ0qfv1xRS
4、医学知识展示 https://t.co/FSiOX9p3cD
```

兄弟们，这个风格你会决绝嘛？🧐
虚拟与现实的融合，经典永不过时。我太爱了❤️！

Prompt 太长影响阅读，见评论区！
通用提示词：
A premium vertical split concept poster for [品牌名称] [产品名称], showing ONE [产品] split in half - left side realistic, right side deconstructed.
TOP SECTION - BRANDING:
- [品牌名称] official logo at top center ([品牌色])
- "[产品名称]" in large bold [字体风格] font in [颜色]
- Subtitle: "[产品Slogan]" in elegant serif font
- Optional secondary tagline
CENTRAL DESIGN - ONE SINGLE [产品] SPLIT VERTICALLY DOWN THE MIDDLE:
LEFT HALF OF THE [产品] (50%): Ultra-realistic photographic half
- Left 50% of the [产品] shown in ultra-realistic photography style
- Photorealistic [关键材质1: 如金属/皮革/食材] texture visible on left edge
- Half of [关键特征1: 如屏幕/面包/表面] with realistic reflections
- Left portion of [关键特征2: 如键盘/配件/层次] showing individual details
- Half of [关键特征3] visible with material accuracy
- Professional product photography lighting
- Perfect vertical cut through the exact center of the [产品]
- Every detail ultra-realistic: [材质细节列表]
- [可选: 烟雾/水珠/光晕] effect for atmosphere
RIGHT HALF OF THE [产品] (50%): Stylized [tech/culinary/artistic] deconstruction
- Right 50% of the [产品] exploding into [解构类型] components
- [组件1] floating away individually [具体描述]
- [组件2] fragments showing [内部结构/发光效果]
- [组件3] pieces with glowing [颜色] [元素: 如芯片/食材/零件]
- [组件4] separating geometrically
- [内部结构] and internal components visible
- [品牌元素/Logo] piece glowing independently
- [Warm golden/Cool blue/Neon multi-color] tech/artistic lighting effects
- Geometric [tech lines/motion lines/artistic trails], [holographic patterns/particle effects/ingredient splashes]
- Components floating outward in organized dynamic composition
- Illustrated/stylized art treatment (not photorealistic)
- [根据类型: 科技感电路/美食解构/时尚元素/机械零件]
THE SPLIT: Clean vertical line down the exact center of the [产品], one continuous [产品] transitioning seamlessly from realistic (left) to deconstructed [风格] art (right)
BACKGROUND: [深色/浅色] gradient ([色值1] to [色值2]) with [carbon fiber/wood/concrete/fabric] texture and [颜色] light particles
LIGHTING: Left side = professional studio lighting with [warm/cool/natural] tone | Right side = [warm/cool/neon] glow with [颜色] accents creating dramatic contrast
VERTICAL DIVIDING LINE: Subtle [golden/silver/blue/red] glow ([色值]) marking the center split of the [产品]
BOTTOM SECTION - PRODUCT FEATURES (arranged horizontally with icons):
- "[特点1]" with [icon描述] icon
- "[特点2]" with [icon描述] icon
- "[特点3]" with [icon描述] icon
- "[特点4]" with [icon描述] icon
Typography in [字体风格] font with decorative divider lines
COLOR PALETTE: [主色调列表]
COMPOSITION: One single [产品] centered vertically, split perfectly down the middle - left half ultra-realistic photography, right half exploding into stylized [解构类型] components
STYLE: Seamless transition from photorealistic product to illustrated [tech/culinary/fashion/mechanical] deconstruction within ONE unified [产品]
MOOD: [Premium/Appetizing/Innovative/Nostalgic], [dramatic/elegant/energetic], official brand advertising quality
TEXT STYLE: Mix of bold display fonts and elegant serifs, [品牌色] colors
Quality: Commercial advertising standard, 4K resolution, dramatic visual impact

案例2：数据可视化信息图
应用场景： 商业分析、学术研究、科学知识原理图等（手册含提供绘制该信息图元提示词）
Prompt：全球变暖对生态系统的多维影响
总体风格与构图： 创建一张复杂、专业、未来主义风格的数据可视化信息图，背景为深色数据流网格。整体色调采用“气候危机”配色方案：中心为炽热的橙红与深蓝对比，向外围逐渐过渡到代表警告的黄色和代表数据的冷灰/紫色。标题在顶部以醒目的大写字母展示：“GLOBAL WARMING: ECOSYSTEM IMPACTS & ACCELERATION (1900-2025 DATA VISUALIZATION)”。
1. 中心核心：发烧的地球 图像中心是一个半透明、发光的地球全息图。地球表面不只是陆地和海洋，还覆盖着一层代表热量的脉动红光，特别是在北极和赤道区域。一条微妙的发光温度计图标插入地球核心，读数显示“CURRENT STATUS: +1.15°C WARMING (Relative to Pre-industrial)”.
2. 环绕核心的三大关键趋势曲线（过去一个世纪 1900-2025） 环绕中心地球的是三条醒目的、带有数据标记的动态曲线图，它们像轨道一样交织。每条曲线都有明确的起点（1900年）和终点（2025年），并标注了关键阈值。
曲线A（上方，炽热红色）：全球平均气温异常 (Global Temperature Anomaly)
曲线形态：起初缓慢上升，1980年后急剧陡峭上升。
关键数据点标记：
1900: "-0.1°C baseline"
1980: "+0.25°C"
2025 (终点): "+1.15°C (Highest on record)"
注释：附带一个小图标显示“巴黎协定1.5°C警戒线”正在逼近。
曲线B（中间，深蓝色）：海平面上升 (Sea Level Rise)
曲线形态：持续、加速的向上弯曲。
关键数据点标记：
1900: "0 mm reference"
1993 (卫星时代开始): "+100mm"
2025 (终点): "+230mm (Accelerating Rate: >4mm/yr)"
注释：下方用小字说明“Thermal Expansion & Ice Melt Contribution”.
曲线C（下方，紫灰色，带有烟雾效果）：大气二氧化碳浓度 (Atmospheric CO₂ Concentration)
曲线形态：最陡峭的指数级增长曲线，突破了历史安全界限。
关键数据点标记：
1900: "~295 ppm"
1950 (大加速开始): "315 ppm"
1988 (350界限突破): "350 ppm (Safe Limit Breached)"
2025 (终点): ">423 ppm (Unprecedented in 2M years)"
3. 左侧面板：极端事件与生物多样性危机（可视化证据） 左侧区域分为上下两个板块，使用卫星图像风格和图表结合。
上板块：极端天气事件频发 (Intensified Extreme Weather)
视觉表现：三个圆形的微缩卫星图视窗。
视窗1（热浪/野火）：卫星图显示大片大陆（如澳洲或加州）呈现红外热成像的深红色，伴有烟雾图标。数据标签：“Heatwave Frequency: 5x Increase since 1950s”.
视窗2（飓风/风暴）：一个巨大的、结构紧密的五级飓风气旋卫星图。数据标签：“Cyclone Intensity: Increased Category 4 & 5 proportion”.
视窗3（极端降雨/洪水）：卫星对比图显示河流泛滥淹没城市区域。数据标签：“Heavy Precipitation Events: More frequent widespread flooding”.
下板块：物种灭绝加速 (Accelerating Biodiversity Loss)
视觉表现：一个漏斗状的图表，顶部是丰富的物种图标（北极熊、珊瑚、两栖动物、昆虫），底部是稀疏的骷髅图标。一条向下急坠的红色箭头。
核心数据图：一个进度条显示“Current Extinction Rate vs. Background Rate”。红色进度条几乎爆表，标注“100x - 1000x Higher”.
关键数据文本：大号字体强调“1 MILLION SPECIES AT RISK (IPBES Report)”. 一个枯萎的珊瑚礁图标旁标注“>90% Coral Reefs at risk at 1.5°C warming”.
4. 右侧面板：关键资源压力（示意图影响） 右侧区域分为上下两个板块，使用工程示意图风格，强调对人类社会系统的影响。
上板块：农业与粮食安全威胁 (Agriculture & Food Security Strain)
视觉表现：一张分裂的世界地图示意图，左侧是干裂的土地和枯萎的玉米（代表干旱带），右侧是正在融化的冻土和不稳定的新作物区（代表高纬度）。
数据示意图：一个带有向下箭头的图表，显示主要作物（小麦、玉米、水稻）在低纬度地区的预计产量。数据标签：“Projected Yield Decline (Tropics): Up to -20% for maize/wheat by mid-century without adaptation”.
注释文本：“Shifting growing zones; Increased pest volatility”.
下板块：水资源短缺与冰川消融 (Water Scarcity & Glacial Retreat)
视觉表现：左侧是一个正在快速退缩的高山冰川示意图，融水流入一条逐渐干涸的河流。右侧是一个水位极低的大坝水库截面图，暴露出干裂的库底。
核心数据：一个水滴图标被划掉，旁边标注：“2+ Billion People living in high water stress regions”.
关键数据标签（指向冰川）： “Glacier Mass Loss: Threatens freshwater supply for huge populations (e.g., Himalayas, Andes)”.
